## Ab Testing

### checkLaunchSuggestions

`abTesting.checkLaunchSuggestions`

Retrieve launch suggestions for an AB Testing configuration. To retrieve Zia AI launch suggestions for a Webform A/B Testing configuration in your Zoho CRM organization, indicating whether the test is ready to launch based on conversion rate analysis.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.abTesting.checkLaunchSuggestions({ id: '487687600000033300' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique [Webform ID](webforms.yaml#$.paths./settings/webforms.get). |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  AB_testing_launch_suggestions?: {
    has_launch_suggestion?: boolean | null,
    conversion_rate_in_abtest?: number | null,
    conversion_rate_outside_abtest?: number | null
  }[] | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### create

`abTesting.create`

Create AB testing configuration. To create a Webform A/B Test in your Zoho CRM organization. Webform A/B testing lets you run an experiment where two or more variations of a webform are shown to different segments of your website visitors, so you can compare their performance and identify the version that delivers the best…

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.abTesting.create({
	module: 'Leads',
	AB_testing: [{
		base_form: {},
		condition: { type: 'duration' },
		module: {},
		name: 'example',
		status: 'drafted',
		variant_form: [{}],
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the module API name for the AB test operation. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve module ID and API name. Possible values: **Leads** - Target the Leads module. |
| `AB_testing` | `object[]` | Yes | Represents the array of AB test configurations to create. The request body must contain a **AB_testing** array with one object. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="AB_testing full type">

```ts
{
  dynamic_allocation_by_zia?: boolean,
  base_form: {
    id?: string,
    traffic?: number | string
  },
  notify?: boolean,
  traffic_diversion?: null,
  variant_form: {
    form_attributes?: {
      width?: 600 | 700 | 800 | 900,
      font_attributes?: {
        size?: number | string,
        color?: string,
        family?: string
      },
      display_form_name?: boolean,
      color?: string,
      align?: right | left | top
    },
    button_attributes?: {
      color?: string,
      name: string
    }[],
    form_fields?: {
      type: general | advanced | portal,
      help?: {
      } | null,
      field?: {
        api_name: string,
        field_label?: string,
        id: string
      },
      hidden?: boolean | null,
      date_format?: string | null,
      required?: boolean | null,
      field_name?: string | null,
      site_key?: string | null,
      secret_key?: string | null,
      recaptcha_label?: string | null,
      theme?: dark | light | null,
      privacy_value?: string | null,
      default_value?: string | null,
      field_info?: {
        type: string,
        field_label?: string
      } | null
    }[],
    traffic?: number | string
  }[],
  traffic?: number | string,
  module: {
    api_name?: string,
    id?: string
  },
  condition: {
    visitors?: number | string,
    unit?: number | string,
    period?: days | weeks | months,
    from?: string,
    to?: string,
    type: duration | range | visits,
    remaining?: number | string
  },
  name: string,
  winner_configuration?: {
    announce_automatically?: true | false,
    conversion_percentage_difference?: number | string
  },
  status: drafted | running | scheduled
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `AB_testing` | `object[] \| null` | No | Represents the list of results for the AB test creation operation. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="AB_testing full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### delete

`abTesting.delete`

Delete an A/B Testing configuration by ID. To delete a Webform A/B Testing configuration by its unique ID from your Zoho CRM organization. Notes: - Deleting an A/B test is permanent. The test configuration and all metrics collected for it are removed and cannot be recovered. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.abTesting.delete({ id: '4876876000000333001', module: 'Leads' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique [AB Testing ID](ab_testing.yaml#$.paths./settings/AB_testing.get). |
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the module API name for the AB test operation. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve module ID and API name. Possible values: **Leads** - Target the Leads module. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `AB_testing` | `object[] \| null` | No | Represents the list of results for the AB test delete operation. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="AB_testing full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Apis

### list

`apis.list`

List available REST APIs. To retrieve the list of available REST API endpoints in your Zoho CRM organization for a specific API version. You can filter the results by module, OAuth scope, or request method using the filters parameter.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.apis.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `filters` | `string` | No | This parameter allows you to filter the supported APIs for the version specified in the URL. You can filter based on three criteria: module, request method, and OAuth scope. The filter syntax is a JSON object with three fields: **field**, **comparator**, and **value**. The **field** can be one of the following: `module`, `operation_types.method`, or `operation_types.oauth_scope`. The **comparator** can be either `equals` or `contains`. The **value** is the value to filter by. Encode the filter while using it in any API platform. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  __apis?: {
    path?: string | null,
    operation_types?: {
      method?: string | null,
      oauth_scope?: string | null,
      max_credits?: number | null,
      min_credits?: number | null
    }[] | null
  }[] | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Appointment Preferences

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.appointments.delete({ appointmentId: 'example' });
```

### list

`appointments.list`

Get Appointment Records. To retrieve appointment records from your Zoho CRM organization. Use the page and per_page parameters to paginate up to 2,000 records, or use the page_token received in a prior response to paginate beyond 2,000 records up to a maximum of 100,000. Each request returns a maximum of 200 records.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.appointments.list({ fields: 'Last_Name,Email' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `fields` | `string` | Yes | Specify a comma-separated list of field API names to include in the response. Use the [Get Fields Metadata API](fields.yaml#$.paths./settings/fields.get) to retrieve the field IDs and API names. |
| `cvid` | `string` | No | Specify the unique ID of the Custom View. Use the [Get Custom Views Metadata API](custom_views.yaml#$.paths./settings/custom_views.get) to retrieve the Custom View IDs. |
| `page_token` | `string` | No | Specify the page token to retrieve records beyond the first 2,000 results. Use the **next_page_token** value from a previous response to access the next page of results. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the page number to retrieve. Starts at 1. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the number of records to return per page. Maximum is 200. |
| `sort_order` | `desc \| asc` | No | Specify the sort order for the records.&lt;br/&gt; &lt;b&gt;Possible values:&lt;/b&gt; &lt;br/&gt;desc - Returns records in descending order.&lt;br/&gt; asc - Returns records in ascending order. |
| `sort_by` | `id \| Created_Time \| Modified_Time` | No | Specify the field to sort records by. Possible values:**id** - Sorts by record ID. **Created_Time** - Sorts by creation timestamp. **Modified_Time** - Sorts by last modification timestamp. |

## Approval Processes

### clone

`approvalProcesses.clone`

### reorder

`approvalProcesses.reorder`

Reorder the execution sequence of approval processes. To reorder the execution sequence of approval processes for a specific module in Zoho CRM. Specify the approval process IDs in the desired sequence. The system updates the execution order of the approval processes for that module.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.approvalProcesses.reorder({
	module: 'Leads',
	reorder: {
		approval_process: [{ id: '4876876000000333001', sequence_number: 1 }],
	},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Approval process's module which needs to be reordered. |
| `reorder` | `object` | Yes | root key for reordering the approval processes. |

<Accordion title="reorder full type">

```ts
{

    sequence_number: number | string,
    id: string
  }[]
}
```

|------|------|----------|-------------|

```ts
} | null
```

### reorderRules

`approvalProcesses.reorderRules`

Reorder the rules of an Approval Process. To update the sequence of rules within one Approval Process, reorder the rules by assigning new sequence numbers to each rule ID in your Zoho CRM organization.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.approvalProcesses.reorderRules({
	approvalProcessId: '4876876000000333001',
	reorder: {
		rules: [{ id: '4876876000000333001', sequence_number: 1 }],
	},
});
```

### create

`assignmentRules.create`

Create an Assignment Rule. To create a single Assignment Rule in your Zoho CRM organization.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.assignmentRules.create({
	module: 'Leads',
	assignment_rules: [{
		name: 'example',
		rule_entries: [{
			assign_to: { type: 'example' },
		}],
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the param query module required schema value for the request. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve module ID and API name. |
| `assignment_rules` | `object[]` | Yes | Array of Assignment Rule objects to be created. |

### delete

`assignmentRules.delete`

Delete an Assignment Rule. To delete a single Assignment Rule from your Zoho CRM organization. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.assignmentRules.delete({ id: '4876876000000333001', module: 'Leads' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the request path param ID value for the request. Use the [Assignment Rule API](assignment_rules.yaml#$.paths./settings/automation/assignment_rules.get) to retrieve the Assignment Rule ID. |
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the param query module required schema value for the request. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve module ID and API name. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

## Attachments

### delete

`attachments.delete`

Delete Link Attachment. Deletes a link attachment associated with a specific record in a module. Note that only link attachments can be deleted using this endpoint; file attachments cannot be deleted through this API. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.attachments.delete({ recordId: '4876876000000333001', moduleApiName: 'Leads', id: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `recordId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the record. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./module.get) to retrieve record IDs. |
| `moduleApiName` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module (e.g., `Leads`, `Contacts`, `Accounts`). Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module API names. |
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the attachment. Use the [Get Attachments](attachments.yaml#$.paths./&#123;moduleApiName&#125;/&#123;recordId&#125;/Attachments.get) resource to retrieve attachment IDs. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | Array of deletion results |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



---

### get

`attachments.get`

Download a specific attachment file. Download the file content of a specific attachment by its ID. This endpoint returns the actual file (image, PDF, document, etc.). Returns an error for link attachments, as they cannot be downloaded.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.attachments.get({ recordId: '4876876000000333001', moduleApiName: 'Leads', id: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `recordId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the record. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./module.get) to retrieve record IDs. |
| `moduleApiName` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module (e.g., `Leads`, `Contacts`, `Accounts`). Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module API names. |
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the attachment. Use the [Get Attachments](attachments.yaml#$.paths./&#123;moduleApiName&#125;/&#123;recordId&#125;/Attachments.get) resource to retrieve attachment IDs. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |



---

### list

`attachments.list`

Retrieve All Attachments. Retrieves all attachments associated with a specific record in a module.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.attachments.list({ recordId: '4876876000000333001', moduleApiName: 'Leads' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `recordId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the record. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./module.get) to retrieve record IDs. |
| `moduleApiName` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module (e.g., `Leads`, `Contacts`, `Accounts`). Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module API names. |
| `fields` | `string` | No | Specify the fields to retrieve. Use the [Get Fields Metadata API](fields.yaml#$.paths./settings/fields.get) to retrieve the field IDs. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

### upload

`attachments.upload`

Upload an Attachment. Uploads an attachment by providing either a file or a valid URL. Maximum request body size: 100MB.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.attachments.upload({ recordId: '4876876000000333001', moduleApiName: 'Leads' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `recordId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the record. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./module.get) to retrieve record IDs. |
| `moduleApiName` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module (e.g., `Leads`, `Contacts`, `Accounts`). Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module API names. |
| `file` | `string \| object \| custom` | No | The file to upload as an attachment |
| `attachmentUrl` | `string` | No | The URL of the attachment to be linked |
| `title` | `string \| null` | No | Optional title for the attachment |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="file full type">

```ts
string | {
  url: string,
  filename?: string,
  contentType?: string
} | {
  base64: string,
  filename?: string,
  contentType?: string
} | custom
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | Array of upload results |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null,
    Modified_Time?: string | null,
    Created_Time?: string | null,
    Modified_By?: {
      id?: string | null,
      name?: string | null
    } | null,
    Created_By?: {
      id?: string | null,
      name?: string | null
    } | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Audit Log Exports

### create

`auditLogExports.create`

Create an audit log export job. To create an asynchronous audit log export job in your Zoho CRM organization. The system schedules the job and returns a unique job ID with a SCHEDULED status code. Use theGet Audit Log Export API to poll for completion and retrieve the download links.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.auditLogExports.create({
	audit_log_export: [{
		criteria: {
			field: { api_name: 'example' },
			comparator: 'example',
			value: 'added',
		},
	}],
});
```

### deactivate

`blueprints.deactivate`

Deactivate Blueprint. To deactivate a published blueprint in your Zoho CRM organization.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.blueprints.deactivate({
	blueprintId: '4876876000000333001',
	blueprints: [{}],
});
```

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

### deleteMany

`blueprints.deleteMany`

Delete one or more Blueprints. To delete one or more Blueprints from your Zoho CRM organization. When multiple Blueprint IDs are passed, if some deletions succeed and others fail, the API responds with 207 Multi-Status. Check the status key in each response item to see the result of each deletion. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.blueprints.deleteMany({
	ids: ['4876876000000333001'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | `string[]` | Yes | Represents the comma-separated list (CSV) of up to 100 [unique Blueprint IDs](blueprints.yaml#$.paths./settings/blueprints.get) to filter the results. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  blueprints?: {
    code?: string | null,
    details?: {
      name?: string | null | null,
      id?: string | null
    } | null,
    message?: string | null,
    status?: string | null
  }[] | null
} | {
  blueprints?: any | null
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### getForRecord

`blueprints.getForRecord`

Get Blueprint transitions of a record. To get the next available Blueprint transitions for a record in Zoho CRM, along with the fields available for each transition, the current value of each field, and their validations, if any.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.blueprints.getForRecord({ moduleApiName: 'Leads', recordId: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `moduleApiName` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module that contains the record. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |
| `recordId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the record for which you want to retrieve or execute Blueprint transitions. |
| `include_inner_details` | `boolean` | No | Specify whether to include inner details, such as the column name of the primary field on which the Blueprint is based, inside the **field** object of **process_info**. Possible values: true - Includes the inner details in the response. false - Excludes the inner details from the response. |

### update

`blueprints.update`

Update a single Blueprint by ID. Updates a specific Blueprint configuration in your Zoho CRM organization by specifying its unique Blueprint ID in the request URL. This operation applies only to blueprints that have never been activated. If the Blueprint has been activated, the operation returns a NOT_ALLOWED error.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.blueprints.update({
	blueprintId: '4876876000000333001',
	blueprints: [{ name: 'example' }],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `blueprintId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the Blueprint to update. Any Blueprint ID included in the request body is ignored. Use the [Get Blueprint by ID](blueprints.yaml#$.paths./settings/blueprints.get) to retrieve the Blueprint ID. |
| `blueprints` | `object[]` | Yes | Represents the list of blueprints to be updated. |

## Bulk Read

### createJob

`bulkRead.createJob`

Create a bulk read job. To create a bulk read job in Zoho CRM. A bulk read job exports records from a specified CRM module to a CSV or ICS file.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.bulkRead.createJob({
	query: {
		module: { api_name: 'example' },
	},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `callback` | `object` | No | Specify the callback configuration to receive a POST notification when the bulk read job completes or fails. |
| `query` | `object` | Yes | Specify the query parameters for the bulk read job, including the target module, optional field selection, optional Custom View, and optional filter criteria. |
| `file_type` | `csv \| ics` | No | Specify the file format for the exported records. Possible values: **csv** - Exports records in CSV format. **ics** - Exports records in ICS format, applicable only when exporting from the **Events** module. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="callback full type">

```ts
{
  url: string,
  method: string
}
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="query full type">

```ts
{
  module: {
    api_name: string
  },
  cvid?: string | null,
  fields?: string[],
  page?: number | string | null,
  criteria?: {
    group_operator: or | and,
    group: {
      field: {
        api_name: string
      },
      value: string,
      type?: string,
      comparator: equal | contains | ends_with | not_contains | not_equal | starts_with
    }[]
  }
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | Represents the list of job creation result objects. |
| `info` | `object \| null` | No | Represents additional metadata about the bulk read job creation response. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  status?: string | null,
  code?: string | null,
  message?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null,
    operation?: string | null,
    state?: string | null,
    created_by?: {
      id?: string | null,
      name?: string | null
    } | null,
    created_time?: string | null
  } | null
}[] | null
```

```ts
} | null
```

### downloadResult

`bulkRead.downloadResult`

Download bulk read result. To download the exported records from a completed bulk read job in Zoho CRM. This API returns a ZIP archive containing the CSV or ICS file with the exported records. The bulk read job must have a COMPLETED state before you can download the result. Returns the job's zip of CSV files.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.bulkRead.downloadResult({ jobId: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `jobId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the bulk read job. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |



---

`bulkRead.getJob`

## Bulk Write

### createJob

`bulkWrite.createJob`

Create a bulk write job. To create a bulk write job in your Zoho CRM organization that creates, updates, or upserts records in a target module from a previously uploaded file.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.bulkWrite.createJob({
	operation: 'insert',
	resource: [{
		type: 'example',
		file_names: ['example'],
		module: { api_name: 'example' },
		file_id: 'example',
		find_by: 'example',
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `character_encoding` | `string \| null` | No | Specify the character encoding of the uploaded file. Zoho CRM auto-detects the encoding when this value is omitted; supply a value to override auto-detection and force the file to be read with the specified charset. |
| `operation` | `insert \| update \| upsert` | Yes | Specify the type of bulk write operation to perform on the file. Possible values: insert - Creates the records from the file as new records in the target module. update - Updates existing records in the target module without creating new ones. upsert - Updates existing records and creates new records that do not exist already. |
| `callback` | `object` | No | Specify the callback configuration that Zoho CRM uses to notify your endpoint when the bulk write job completes or fails. |
| `resource` | `object[]` | Yes | Specify the list of resource configurations to process in the bulk write job. Each entry describes the target module, the uploaded file to read, and the field mappings to apply. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="callback full type">

```ts
{
  url: string,
  method: string
}
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="resource full type">

```ts
{
  type: string,
  file_names: string[],
  module: {
    api_name: string
  },
  file_id: string,
  ignore_empty?: boolean,
  find_by: string,
  field_mappings?: {
    api_name: string,
    index: number | string
  }[]
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | Represents the overall status of the bulk write job creation request. Possible values: success - Indicates that Zoho CRM scheduled the bulk write job successfully. Example: "success". |
| `code` | `string \| null` | No | Represents the response code returned for the bulk write job creation. Possible values: **SUCCESS** - Indicates that the bulk write job was scheduled successfully. **FILE_UPLOAD_SUCCESS** - Indicates that the file associated with the job was uploaded successfully. |
| `message` | `string \| null` | No | Represents the response message for the bulk write job creation. Possible values: **success** - Confirms that Zoho CRM scheduled the bulk write job. **file uploaded** - Confirms that Zoho CRM accepted the uploaded file for the job. |
| `details` | `object \| null` | No | Represents the details of the newly scheduled bulk write job. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="details full type">

```ts
{
  id?: string | null,
  created_by?: {
    id?: string | null,
    name?: string | null
  } | null
} | null
```

### uploadFile

`bulkWrite.uploadFile`

Upload a file to CRM. To upload a CSV file in ZIP format for bulk write API. The response contains the file_id. Use this ID while making the bulk write request. Goes to Zoho's upload host (upload.zoho.&lt;dc&gt;). Needs the org id (crmOrgId, from org.get: zgid) and feature "bulk-write". The file is a CSV, or a zip of one.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.bulkWrite.uploadFile({
	file: { base64: 'SGVsbG8gZnJvbSBDb3JzYWly', filename: 'notes.txt', contentType: 'text/plain' },
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `crmOrgId` | `number \| string` | No | Static CRM organization identifier. This value is fixed per account and shared during onboarding. |
| `feature` | `string` | No | Specify the feature for which the file upload is being performed. Possible values: **bulk-write** - Indicates a bulk write operation. |
| `file` | `string \| object \| custom` | Yes | Specify the file to upload. The file must be a ZIP archive containing one or more CSV files, with a maximum of **25,000 records** per file. The maximum file size is **25 MB.** If there are more records, make a separate API call by with a ZIP file containing the next 25,000 records in the module. Please note that the **Subform** and **multi-module lookup (MxN linking module)** fields are treated as separate modules in Zoho CRM. This is a parent-child modulecase, for example, the Contacts module is the parent module, and the subform within it is the child module. So, **prepare separate CSV files for parent and child modules**, then ZIP them together into a ZIP file and upload. For more details on preparing the input file for parent-child record imports, refer to [Kaizen #131 - Bulk Write for parent-child records using Scala SDK.](https://help.zoho.com/portal/en/community/topic/kaizen-131-bulk-write-for-parent-child-records-scala-sdk) |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="file full type">

```ts
string | {
  url: string,
  filename?: string,
  contentType?: string
} | {
  base64: string,
  filename?: string,
  contentType?: string
} | custom
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | Represents the status of the upload operation. Possible values: **success** - The file was uploaded successfully. Example: "success". |
| `code` | `string \| null` | No | Represents the result code for the upload operation. Possible values: **FILE_UPLOAD_SUCCESS** - The file was uploaded successfully. Example: "FILE_UPLOAD_SUCCESS". |
| `message` | `string \| null` | No | Represents the message confirming the outcome of the upload operation. Example: "file uploaded.". |
| `details` | `object \| null` | No | Represents the details of the uploaded file, including the file ID and creation time. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="details full type">

```ts
{
  file_id?: string | null,
  created_time?: string | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### enrollRecords

`cadences.enrollRecords`

Enroll Records to Cadences. Enrolls CRM records into one or more cadences. Notes - Only Manual Enrollment cadences can be enrolled through this API. - Available only in Enterprise edition and above. - Supports Leads, Contacts, Deals, Vendors, and custom modules. - A request may contain up to 5 cadence IDs. Enrolled records start receiving the cadence's follow-up emails and tasks.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.cadences.enrollRecords({
	module: 'Leads',
	cadences_ids: ['example'],

});
```

| `cadences_ids` | `string[]` | Yes | A list of Cadence IDs to use for the enrollment or un-enrollment operation. |
| `ids` | `string[]` | Yes | Specify the list of record IDs to enroll in or un-enroll from the specified Cadences. |

The filter value must be URL-encoded before being sent in the query parameter. ### publish

`cadences.publish`

Publish a Cadence. Publishes a draft cadence by merging its follow-up tree, transitions, and triggers into the live cadence, and then clears the draft. If the cadence is being published for the first time, it is promoted from a draft to an inactive published cadence.

## Composite Requests

### execute

`compositeRequests.execute`

Process multiple API requests in a single call. To bundle multiple Zoho CRM API requests into a single HTTP call, reducing network round-trips and enabling request chaining. You can reference the output of one sub-request in another using the format @&#123;sub_request_id:JSONPath&#125; to build dependent workflows. Runs up to five API calls in one request, writes and deletes included.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.compositeRequests.execute({
	__composite_requests: [{ method: 'GET', uri: '/crm/v8/Leads' }],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `rollback_on_fail` | `boolean` | No | Specify whether to rollback the composite API request if any of the sub-requests fail. The default value is false. Possible values: **true** - Rollback all operations if any sub-request fails. Workflow automation actions execute only after all sub-requests succeed. **false** - Process each sub-request independently without rollback. This key cannot be **true** when **parallel_execution** is **true**. |
| `parallel_execution` | `boolean` | No | Specify whether to process all independent sub-requests (sub-requests with no dependencies/references) in parallel. The default value is true. If "rollback_on_fail" is true, then the default value of this key is false. Possible values: **true** - Execute independent sub-requests in parallel. **false** - Execute sub-requests sequentially. This key cannot be **true** when **rollback_on_fail** is **true**. |
| `__composite_requests` | `object[]` | Yes | Specify the API requests to execute as sub-requests within the composite call. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="__composite_requests full type">

```ts
{
  method: GET | POST | PUT | DELETE | PATCH,
  uri: string,
  sub_request_id?: string,
  headers?: {
  },
  params?: {
  },
  body?: {
  }
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  __composite_requests?: {
    code?: string | null,
    message?: string | null,
    status?: string | null,
    details?: {
      response?: {
        headers?: {
        } | null,
        body?: {
        } | null,
        status_code?: number | null
      } | null
    } | null
  }[] | null
} | {
  __composite_requests?: {
  }[] | null
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Coql

### query

`coql.query`

Retrieve records using a COQL query. To retrieve records from one or more Zoho CRM modules using a COQL SELECT query, with support for cross-module joins, aggregate functions, and flexible filtering. select_query is a COQL statement such as "select Last_Name from Leads where Last_Name is not null limit 10". Every WHERE clause needs at least one condition.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.coql.query({ select_query: 'select Last_Name, Email from Leads where Last_Name is not null limit 10' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `select_query` | `string` | Yes | Specify the COQL SELECT query to retrieve records. The query must reference module and field API names. |
| `include_meta` | `string[]` | No | Specify the list of metadata types to include in the response. Possible values: **fields** - Includes field metadata for the SELECT columns in the response. |

## Custom Views

### changeSort

`customViews.changeSort`

Sort Order by ID. To change the sort field and sort order for a specific Custom View in the specified module of your Zoho CRM organization. Use the Get Custom Views Metadata API to retrieve the custom view IDs.".

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.customViews.changeSort({
	module: 'Leads',
	id: '4876876000000333001',
	custom_views: [{
		sort_by: {},
		sort_order: 'asc',
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module for which to manage Custom Views. Refer to the Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve module IDs.resource for valid values. |
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the Custom View. Use the [Get Custom View API](custom_views.yaml#$.paths./settings/custom_views.get) to retrieve the custom view IDs. |
| `custom_views` | `object[]` | Yes | Specify the sort order configuration to apply to the Custom View. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="custom_views full type">

```ts
{
  sort_by: {
    api_name?: string | null,
    id?: string | null
  },
  sort_order: asc | desc,
  id?: string
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `custom_views` | `object[] \| null` | No | Represents the list of Custom View update success items. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="custom_views full type">

```ts
{
  status?: string | null,
  code?: string | null,
  message?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### deleteMany

`customViews.deleteMany`

Delete Custom Views. To delete one or more Custom Views from a specified module in your Zoho CRM organization. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.customViews.deleteMany({
	ids: ['4876876000000333001'],
	module: 'Leads',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | `string[]` | Yes | Specify the comma-separated list of unique IDs of the Custom Views to delete. Accepts up to 100 IDs. Use the [Get Custom Views API](custom_views.yaml#$.paths./settings/custom_views.get) to retrieve the custom view IDs. |
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module for which to manage Custom Views. Refer to the Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve module IDs.resource for valid values. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  custom_views?: {
    status?: string | null,
    code?: string | null,
    details?: {
      id?: string | null
    } | null,
    message?: string | null
  }[] | null
} | {
  custom_views?: any & any | null
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### get

`customViews.get`

Get Custom View By Id. To retrieve the details of a specific Custom View for a module in your Zoho CRM organization, using the Custom View ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.customViews.get({ id: '4876876000000333001', module: 'Leads' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the Custom View. Use the [Get Custom View API](custom_views.yaml#$.paths./settings/custom_views.get) to retrieve the custom view IDs. |
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module for which to manage Custom Views. Refer to the Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve module IDs.resource for valid values. |
| `include_inner_details` | `string` | No | Specify whether to include the inner details of criteria and cross filters in the response. Possible values: **inner_details** - Includes the full criteria and cross filter details in the response. |



**Output:** `object`

### list

`customViews.list`

Get All Custom Views. To retrieve the list of all Custom Views configured for a specified module in your Zoho CRM organization.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.customViews.list({ module: 'Leads' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module for which to manage Custom Views. Refer to the Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve module IDs.resource for valid values. |
| `filters` | `object` | No | Represents the top-level filter criterion for data selection, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the page number for pagination. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the number of Custom Views to return per page. |
| `ids` | `string[]` | No | Specify the comma-separated list of unique IDs of the Custom Views to delete. Accepts up to 100 IDs. Use the [Get Custom Views API](custom_views.yaml#$.paths./settings/custom_views.get) to retrieve the custom view IDs. |
| `scope` | `created_by_me \| shared_with_me \| public_views \| other_users_views` | No | Represents the category of custom views to fetch. Allowed values are 'created_by_me', 'shared_with_me', 'public_views', 'other_users_views'. |
| `favourite` | `boolean` | No | Filter custom views by favourite status. Set to true to fetch only favourite custom views. |

---

### update

`customViews.update`

CustomView update. To update the configuration of a specific Custom View in a module of your Zoho CRM organization, using the Custom View ID. Use the Get Custom Views API to retrieve the custom view IDs.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.customViews.update({
	module: 'Leads',
	id: '4876876000000333001',
	custom_views: [{}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module for which to manage Custom Views. Refer to the Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve module IDs.resource for valid values. |
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the Custom View. Use the [Get Custom View API](custom_views.yaml#$.paths./settings/custom_views.get) to retrieve the custom view IDs. |
| `custom_views` | `object[]` | Yes | Specify the list of Custom View configurations to update. |

### updateMany

`customViews.updateMany`

Custom Views. To update the configuration of one or more Custom Views in bulk for a specified module in your Zoho CRM organization.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.customViews.updateMany({ module: 'Leads' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module for which to manage Custom Views. Refer to the Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve module IDs.resource for valid values. |
| `custom_views` | `object[]` | No | Specify the list of Custom Views to update in bulk. Each object must include the Custom View ID and the fields to update. |

## Email Notifications

### create

`emailNotifications.create`

Create Email Notifications. Creates an email notification action in your Zoho CRM organization by defining its name, associated module, email template, sender details, and recipients. The email notification can be linked to automation rules so that emails are automatically triggered when the specified conditions are met.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.emailNotifications.create({
	email_notifications: [{
		module: { api_name: 'example', id: '4876876000000333001' },
		name: 'example',
		recipients: {
			to: [{
				type: 'example',
				details: { api_name: 'example' },
			}],
		},
		template: { name: 'example', id: '4876876000000333001' },
	}],
});
```

### delete

`emailNotifications.delete`

Delete an Email Notification by ID. Deletes a single email notification configured in your Zoho CRM organization. Email notifications associated with an Approval Process, Workflow Rules, or Blueprint cannot be deleted until they are disassociated from the corresponding automation. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.emailNotifications.delete({ id: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the email notification to delete. Notifications associated with active automation cannot be deleted - returns NOT_ALLOWED |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `email_notifications` | `object[] \| null` | No | Represents the result of the delete operation for the specified email notification. |

<Accordion title="email_notifications full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### getUsageReports

`emailNotifications.getUsageReports`

Get Email Notification Action Usage Reports. Retrieves usage statistics for email notification actions executed in your Zoho CRM organization over a specified date range, grouped by date, resource, or type according to the group_by parameter.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.emailNotifications.getUsageReports({ group_by: 'date' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `group_by` | `date \| date,resource \| date,resource,type` | Yes | Specify the grouping criteria for usage report data. The value must include `date`. Two combinations are accepted: `date` - Returns daily totals; the response omits the resource object, and the count represents the total number of alerts sent that day. `date,resource` - Returns per-action rows with the resource identifier and name populated; type is an optional addition. |
| `type` | `workflow_rules \| approval_process \| blueprint \| orchestrations \| wizards \| modules \| email_notifications \| email_templates \| kiosks \| cadences \| connected_workflows` | No | Specify the automation feature type to filter usage data. When omitted, returns usage across all supported feature types. Possible values: workflow_rules - Filters usage data for Workflow Rules. approval_process - Filters usage data for Approval Processes. blueprint - Filters usage data for Blueprint Processes. orchestrations - Filters usage data for Orchestrations. wizards - Filters usage data for Wizards. modules - Filters usage data for module-level limits. email_notifications - Filters usage data for email notification actions. email_templates - Filters usage data for Email Templates. kiosks - Filters usage data for Kiosks. cadences - Filters usage data for Cadences. connected_workflows - Filters usage data for connected workflows. |
| `from` | `string` | No | Specify the start date (inclusive) for the date range filter, in YYYY-MM-DD format. The date is evaluated in the organization's time zone. When omitted, defaults to 30 days before the value set for the end date parameter. Future dates return an INVALID_DATA error. |
| `to` | `string` | No | Specify the end date (inclusive) for the query range in YYYY-MM-DD format. Evaluated in the organization's time zone. Defaults to the current date at 23:59:59 when omitted. Future dates return a 400 error with the code INVALID_DATA and the message 'provided_time_is_ahead'. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the page number to retrieve results from. The first page is page one. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the number of records to return per page. The maximum value is 200. |
| `sort_order` | `desc \| asc` | No | Specify the sort order for the results. Possible values: desc - Sorts the results in descending order. asc - Sorts the results in ascending order. |
| `include_inner_details` | `string` | No | Specify the additional nested fields to include in usage report resource objects. Currently, only `resource.layout_id` is supported, which adds the layout ID inside the resource object when available, primarily for wizard usage rows. Other values are silently ignored. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  data_usage?: {
    date?: string | null,
    resource?: {
      id?: string | null,
      name?: string | null,
      layout_id?: string | null
    } | null,
    count?: number | null,
    type?: string | null
  }[] | null,
  info?: {
    per_page?: number | null,
    count?: number | null,
    page?: number | null,
    more_records?: boolean | null,
    max_limit?: number | null
  } | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### list

`emailNotifications.list`

List Email Notifications. Retrieves the list of email notifications configured in your Zoho CRM organization.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.emailNotifications.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `filters` | `string` | No | Specify the filter criteria as a JSON-encoded string to narrow the list of email notifications returned. Supported filter field: `field.api_name='name'` with `comparator='contains'`. The value field is dynamic and varies based on the filter input. |
| `module` | `string` | No | Specify the API name of the CRM module to filter the results. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |
| `related_module` | `string` | No | Specify the API name of the related module to filter the results. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |
| `feature_type` | `workflow \| approval_process \| blueprint \| blueprint_transition \| blueprint_state \| review_process \| orchestration \| assignment_rules \| kiosk \| pathfinder \| connected_workflows \| commandcenter_service \| cadences` | No | Specify the automation feature type to filter the results. When omitted, returns email notifications across all feature types. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the page number to retrieve results from. The first page is page one. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the number of records to return per page. The maximum value is 200. |
| `sort_by` | `string` | No | Specify the field by which to sort the results. Currently, only `modified_time` is supported. |
| `sort_order` | `desc \| asc` | No | Specify the sort order for the results. Possible values: desc - Sorts the results in descending order. asc - Sorts the results in ascending order. |

### update

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.emailNotifications.update({
	id: '4876876000000333001',
	email_notifications: [{
		name: 'example',
		template: { name: 'example', id: '4876876000000333001' },
		recipients: {

	}],
});
```

## Emails

### associate

`emails.associate`

Associate Email. Associates an email with a specific record in a module, creating a link between the email and the CRM record.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.emails.associate({
	module: 'Leads',
	recordId: '4876876000000333001',
	data: [{
		from: { email: 'ada@example.com' },
		to: [{ email: 'ada@example.com' }],
		subject: 'example',
		content: 'example',
		original_message_id: 'example',
		sent: true,
		date_time: 'example',
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | The API name of the module containing the record. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module API names. |
| `recordId` | `string` | Yes | The unique ID of the record to associate the email with. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./module.get) to retrieve record IDs. |
| `data` | `object[]` | Yes | List of email objects to associate with the record. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  from: {
    user_name?: string,
    email: string
  },
  to: {
    user_name?: string,
    email: string
  }[],
  cc?: {
    user_name?: string,
    email: string
  }[],
  bcc?: {
    user_name?: string,
    email: string
  }[],
  subject: string,
  content: string,
  mail_format?: text | html,
```

### downloadAttachments

`emails.downloadAttachments`

Download an email attachment. To download the binary content of an attachment that belongs to an email associated with a record in your Zoho CRM organization.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.emails.downloadAttachments({
	module: 'Leads',
	recordId: '4876876000000333001',
	user_id: 1,
	message_id: 'example',
	id: '4876876000000333001',
	name: 'example',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the CRM module that contains the record associated with the email. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for module details. |
| `recordId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the record that the email is associated with. |
| `user_id` | `number \| string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the user who sent the email. Refer to the [Get Users](users.yaml#$.paths./users.get) resource for valid values. |
| `message_id` | `string` | Yes | The message ID you get in the response when you send an email. Refer to the "message_id" key in the response of [Send Mail API](send_mail.yaml#$.paths.//&#123;moduleName&#125;/&#123;id&#125;/actions/send_mail.post) or [Get Emails](emails.yaml#$.paths./&#123;moduleApiName&#125;/&#123;id&#125;/Emails.get) of a Record API to get the message ID. |
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the attachment to download. |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | Specify the file name of the attachment to download. You can get this from the response of [Get Emails API](emails.yaml#$.paths./&#123;moduleApiName&#125;/&#123;id&#125;/Emails.get). |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |

### unblock

`emails.unblock`

Unblock email for a single record. To unblock a soft-bounced email address for a single record in your Zoho CRM organization. When an email sent from CRM bounces temporarily, the Email field on the affected record is blocked. This operation removes that block so email communication with the record can resume.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.emails.unblock({
	module: 'Leads',
	id: '4876876000000333001',
	unblock_fields: ['example'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Represents the module API name. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to get valid values. |
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Represents the unique ID of the record. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./&#123;module&#125;.get) to get valid values. |
| `unblock_fields` | `string[]` | Yes | To unblock emails, specify one or both of the system-defined fields : **Email** and **Secondary_Email**. &gt; **Note** &gt; - The permanently blocked emails cannot be unblocked. &gt; - A temporarily blocked email can be unblocked up to **5 times**. &gt; - A **custom email field** cannot be unblocked. &gt; - You cannot merge records that are **locked** or in an **Approval Process/Review Process**. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `code` | `string \| null` | No | Represents the status code of the unblock operation. Example: "SUCCESS". |
| `details` | `object \| null` | No | Contains the details of the record for which the email was unblocked. |
| `message` | `string \| null` | No | Represents the descriptive message returned by the server for the unblock operation. |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | Represents the overall status of the unblock operation for the record. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="details full type">

```ts
{
  id?: string | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



---

### list

`features.list`

Features. To retrieve the list of all features available in your Zoho CRM organization for the current subscription edition, along with their usage limits and component details.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.features.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | No | Specify the API name of the CRM module to filter features that are specific to that module. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.json#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |
| `api_names` | `custom_field \| custom_field,encrypt_field,unique_field,private_fields,external_field,personal_health_fields \| personal_health_fields \| encrypt_field \| external_field \| unique_field \| private_fields` | No | Specify the feature API names to filter the response. To retrieve details of more than one feature, provide the names in comma-separated format. Possible values: custom_field - Feature API name for the custom field feature. custom_field,encrypt_field,unique_field,private_fields,external_field,personal_health_fields - Feature API names for multiple features specified together. encrypt_field - Feature API name for the encrypt field feature. external_field - Feature API name for the external field feature. personal_health_fields - Feature API name for the personal health fields feature. private_fields - Feature API name for the private fields feature. unique_field - Feature API name for the unique field feature. |
| `per_page` | `string` | No | Specify the number of features to return per page. Possible values: 10 - Returns ten features per page. |
| `page` | `1 \| 2` | No | Specify the page number to retrieve features from the corresponding results page. Possible values: 1 - Retrieves features from page one. 2 - Retrieves features from page two. |

### delete

`fields.delete`

Delete a custom field. To delete a custom field from a module in your Zoho CRM account. The field must not be used in workflows, approvals, scoring rules, or other configurations before deletion. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.fields.delete({ fieldId: 'example', module: 'Leads' });
```

**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|

### get

`fields.get`

Get field metadata by ID. To retrieve the metadata of a specific custom field in a module in your Zoho CRM account by its field ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.fields.get({ module: 'Leads', fieldId: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module for which you want to retrieve field data. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |
| `fieldId` | `string` | Yes | Id of the resource. |
| `include` | `string` | No | Specify whether to include the **allowed_permissions** JSON object in the response. Possible values: allowed_permissions_to_update - Includes the allowed_permissions JSON object with details about the default permissions for each field. |
| `type` | `all \| unused \| used` | No | Specify the usage type of the fields to retrieve. Possible values: all - Retrieves both used and unused fields in the module. unused - Retrieves only fields that are not in use. used - Retrieves only fields that are currently in use. |

### getScheduledJobs

`fields.getScheduledJobs`

Get scheduled jobs for a field. To retrieve the status of scheduled jobs for picklist field operations in your Zoho CRM account, such as replace or delete picklist option jobs.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.fields.getScheduledJobs({ module: 'Leads', fieldId: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `job_id` | `string` | No | Specify the job ID of the scheduled field or picklist action to filter the results. |
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module for which you want to retrieve field data. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the page number for paginating the scheduled jobs list. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the number of scheduled jobs to return per page. |
| `fieldId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the custom field. |

### list

`fields.list`

List fields metadata. To retrieve the field metadata for the specified module in your Zoho CRM account, including standard, custom, subform, and linking module fields. The response includes fields from all layouts but does not contain layout-specific configurations such as mandatory flags or picklist values.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.fields.list({ module: 'Leads' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module for which you want to retrieve field data. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |
| `include` | `string` | No | Specify whether to include the **allowed_permissions** JSON object in the response. Possible values: allowed_permissions_to_update - Includes the allowed_permissions JSON object with details about the default permissions for each field. |
| `type` | `all \| unused \| used` | No | Specify the usage type of the fields to retrieve. Possible values: all - Retrieves both used and unused fields in the module. unused - Retrieves only fields that are not in use. used - Retrieves only fields that are currently in use. |



**Output:** `object`

## Field Updates

### create

`fieldUpdates.create`

Create Field Update. Creates a field update action that assigns a static value to a field, triggered by a workflow rule. For single-value fields, use a string for value. For multi-select and multi-user field types, use an array for value (for example, ['Call', 'Advertisement']).

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.fieldUpdates.create({
	field_updates: [{
		name: 'example',
		module: { api_name: 'example' },
		field: { id: '4876876000000333001', api_name: 'example' },
		value: 'example',
		type: 'example',
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `field_updates` | `object[]` | Yes | Array containing one field update configuration object. Exactly one item is allowed per request. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="field_updates full type">

```ts
{
  name: string,
  module: {
    singular_label?: string,
    moduleName?: string,
    id?: string,
    plural_label?: string,
    api_name: string
  },
  field: {
    ui_type?: number | string,
    id: string,
    api_name: string,
    field_label?: string,
    data_type?: string
  },
  value: string | string[] | {
    id: string,
    name?: string
  } | boolean | number | null,
  type: string,
  feature_type?: workflow | approval_process | blueprint_transition | blueprint_state | assignment_rules | kiosk | commandcenter_service | connected_workflows,
  notify?: boolean,

  apply_assignment_threshold?: boolean,
  dependent_fields?: {

      data_type?: string
    },
    dependent_fields?: {

      },

          id: string,

        },

      }[],
      value: string
    }[],

  }[] | null,

    api_name: Events | Calls | Tasks | Contacts | Deals,

  }[] | null,

}[]
```

### delete

`fieldUpdates.delete`

Delete Field Update. Deletes a single field update action identified by the path ID. Use the Get Field Updates API to retrieve the field update ID. Actions associated with active automation rules return a NOT_ALLOWED error, and read-only actions cannot be deleted. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.fieldUpdates.delete({ id: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Unique identifier of the field update action. Use the [Get Field Updates API](field_updates.yaml#$.paths./settings/automation/field_updates.get) to retrieve the field update IDs. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `field_updates` | `object[] \| null` | No | Array containing the deleted field update action. Contains exactly one item. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="field_updates full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



---

### deleteMany

`fieldUpdates.deleteMany`

To delete multiple field update actions. Deletes multiple Field Update actions specified by their IDs. Specify the action IDs as a comma-separated list using the ids query parameter. You can delete a maximum of 10 actions in a single request. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.fieldUpdates.deleteMany({ ids: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | `string` | Yes | The unique field update IDs you want to delete. Use the [Get Field Updates API](field_updates.yaml#$.paths./settings/automation/field_updates.get) to retrieve the IDs. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts

  field_updates?: {
    code?: string | null,
    details?: {
      id?: string | null
    } | null,
    message?: string | null,
    status?: string | null
  }[] | null
} | {
  field_updates?: (
    {
      code?: string | null,
      details?: {
        id?: string | null
      } | null,
      message?: string | null,
      status?: string | null
    } | {
      code?: string | null,
      details?: {
        id?: string | null
      } | null,
      message?: string | null,
      status?: string | null
    }
  )[] | null
}
```

### get

`fieldUpdates.get`

Get Field Update By Id. Retrieves the details of the specified Field Update action, including its field configuration, module details, configured value, dependent fields, and audit information. Specify the Field Update ID in the path parameter.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.fieldUpdates.get({ id: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Unique identifier of the field update action. Use the [Get Field Updates API](field_updates.yaml#$.paths./settings/automation/field_updates.get) to retrieve the field update IDs. |
| `include_inner_details` | `field_label \| enable_colour_code \| pick_list_values.colour_code \| data_type \| display_value` | No | Include optional field metadata in the response. `field_label`: UI label, `enable_colour_code`: picklist color-coding flag, `pick_list_values.colour_code`: HEX color per picklist option, `data_type`: field data type, `display_value`: UI-friendly rendered value. |

### list

`fieldUpdates.list`

Get Field Updates. Retrieves a paginated list of field update actions. OPTIONAL FILTERS: module (string — filter by module API name), related_module (string — filter by related module API name), feature_type ('workflow'), sort_by, sort_order, page, per_page.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.fieldUpdates.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `filter` | `string` | No | Advanced filter criteria (JSON-encoded string). Supported only: **field.api_name='name'** and **comparator='contains'**. The value field is dynamic. |
| `module` | `string` | No | Filter by CRM module API name. Use module API names from the Zoho CRM Modules API (for example: Leads, Contacts, Deals). Use the [Modules metadata API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules/.get) to get module API names and IDs. |
| `related_module` | `string` | No | Filter by related module API name. Use related module API names from the Zoho CRM Modules API (for example: Notes). Use the [Modules metadata API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to get module API names. |
| `feature_type` | `workflow \| approval_process \| blueprint \| blueprint_transition \| blueprint_state \| review_process \| orchestration \| assignment_rules \| kiosk \| pathfinder \| connected_workflows \| commandcenter_service` | No | Filter field updates by automation feature type. |
| `sort_order` | `desc \| asc` | No | Sort order for the results based on sort_by. Allowed values: desc, asc. |
| `sort_by` | `string` | No | Sort field for list response. Default sorting is by created_time; currently supported explicit value is modified_time. |
| `include_inner_details` | `field_label \| enable_colour_code \| pick_list_values.colour_code \| data_type \| display_value` | No | Include optional field metadata in the response. `field_label`: UI label, `enable_colour_code`: picklist color-coding flag, `pick_list_values.colour_code`: HEX color per picklist option, `data_type`: field data type, `display_value`: UI-friendly rendered value. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Page number (1-based). |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Indicates records per page. Maximum 200. |



**Output:** `object`

### update

`fieldUpdates.update`

Update Field Update. Updates an existing field update action identified by the path ID. Use the Get Field Updates API to find the field update ID. Locked actions require the appropriate privilege, and read-only actions cannot be modified. For single-value fields, use a string for value.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.fieldUpdates.update({
	id: '4876876000000333001',
	field_updates: [{
		name: 'example',
		module: { api_name: 'example' },
		field: { id: '4876876000000333001', api_name: 'example' },
		value: 'example',
		type: 'example',
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Unique identifier of the field update action. Use the [Get Field Updates API](field_updates.yaml#$.paths./settings/automation/field_updates.get) to retrieve the field update IDs. |
| `field_updates` | `object[]` | Yes | Array containing one field update configuration object. Exactly one item is allowed per request. |

## Files

### download

`files.download`

Retrieve a file from ZFS. To retrieve the binary content of a file stored in Zoho File System (ZFS) using its unique file ID. The file ID is provided as a required query parameter 'id'.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.files.download({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | No | Specify the encrypted file ID received in the response when uploading files to the Zoho File System. Use the [ZFC API](files.yaml#$.paths./files.get) to retrieve the File IDs. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |

### upload

`files.upload`

Upload files to ZFS. To upload one or more files to the Zoho File System (ZFS) in your Zoho CRM account. The API returns an encrypted file ID for each uploaded file, which you can use to attach the file to a file upload field, image upload field, or record image field through the Create or Update Records API.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.files.upload({

});
```

### list

`functions.list`

Functions. To retrieve a paginated list of all functions in your Zoho CRM account. The response contains metadata about each function, including its name, API name, runtime, category, state, arguments, tags, and timestamps.

To retrieve records beyond the first 2,000, use the **page_token** parameter. Do not use this parameter with the page_token parameter. **Possible Values:** Positive integers **Default Value:** 1 |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the maximum number of functions to retrieve per page. This value also determines the number of functions returned when the corresponding **page_token** is used. You cannot use this parameter with the **page_token** parameter. **Possible Values:** 1 to 200. **Default Value:** 200. |
| `page_token` | `string` | No | The token to retrieve functions beyond the first 2000 records. Use the **next_page_token** or **previous_page_token** value from the previous response to retrieve the next or previous set of functions, respectively. The API returns the same number of functions as the **per_page** value used in the request that generated the token. If **page_token** is specified along with **page** or **per_page**, the **page_token** value takes precedence. |

### publish

`functions.publish`

Publish a function. This API is applicable only to Java, Node.js, and Python functions. The function must have an unpublished draft version before it can be published. Deluge functions are automatically published when they are created or updated and cannot be published using this API.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.functions.publish({ fxIdentifier: '4876876000000333001' });
```

| `publish` | `object` | No | Specify the publish configuration for the function. For **Deluge** functions, specifying this object records the changelog for the published revision. Deluge functions are published automatically regardless of whether this object is specified or not. For **Java, Node.js**, and **Python** functions, specifying this object attempts to publish the function after it is created. If this object is omitted, the function is created in the unpublished state. In that case, use the [Publish Function API](functions.yaml#$.paths./settings/functions/&#123;fxIdentifier&#125;/actions/publish.post) to publish the function later. |

### create

`globalPicklists.create`

Create a Global Picklist. Creates a new global picklist with the specified display label, API name, description, and picklist values. The actual_label, customizable, modified_by, created_by, and presence properties are generated by the backend. In pick_list_values, only display_value and type are considered.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.globalPicklists.create({
	global_picklists: [{
		display_label: 'example',
		pick_list_values: [{ display_value: 'example', type: 'unused' }],
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `global_picklists` | `object[]` | Yes | Array containing the global picklist to create. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="global_picklists full type">

```ts
{
  display_label: string,
  api_name?: string,
  description?: string | null,
  pick_list_values_sorted_lexically?: boolean,
  pick_list_values: {
    display_value: string,
    type: unused | used
  }[]
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `global_picklists` | `object[] \| null` | No | Array containing the created global picklist response. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="global_picklists full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>
