### delete

`globalPicklists.delete`

Delete a Global Picklist by ID. Deletes a single global picklist identified by the path parameter \&#123;id\&#125;. This request is asynchronous: a 202 Accepted indicates deletion has been scheduled and the response contains a job_id in details. There is no status-check endpoint. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.globalPicklists.delete({ id: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Numeric id of the global picklist. Use the [Get All Global Picklists](global_picklists.yaml#$.paths./settings/global_picklists.get) resource to retrieve global picklist IDs. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `global_picklists` | `object[] \| null` | No | Array containing the scheduled deletion response. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="global_picklists full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  message?: string | null,
  details?: {
    job_id?: string | null
  } | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### get

`globalPicklists.get`

Get a Single Global Picklist by ID. Fetches the global picklist for given id along with their pick_list_values. used_in_modules, and associated_fields_count can be included in the response based on the 'include' query parameter.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.globalPicklists.get({ id: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Numeric id of the global picklist. Use the [Get All Global Picklists](global_picklists.yaml#$.paths./settings/global_picklists.get) resource to retrieve global picklist IDs. |
| `include` | `(used_in_modules \| pick_list_values \| associated_fields_count)[]` | No | Comma-separated list of related resources to include. Allowed values: "used_in_modules", "pick_list_values", "associated_fields_count". Use CSV encoding (style=form, explode=false) for multiple values, e.g. include=used_in_modules,pick_list_values. |
| `include_inner_details` | `string` | No | Optional detailed expansion keys. Currently only allowed when `used_in_modules` is present in `include`. Allowed value: used_in_modules.plural_label. |
| `fields` | `string[]` | No | Comma-separated list of the api_names of the global picklist keys to be returned in the response, which lets you filter the response by key. Only the requested keys along with `id` are returned. Keys need not be unique — a key repeated in the list is processed once and the duplicates are ignored. Use CSV encoding (style=form, explode=false) for multiple values, e.g. fields=display_label,api_name,customizable. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  global_picklists?: {
    display_label?: string | null,
    api_name?: string | null,
    source?: string | null,
    created_time?: string | null | null,
    modified_time?: string | null | null,
    id?: string | null,
    actual_label?: string | null,
    description?: string | null | null,
    associated_fields_count?: number | null,
    modified_by?: {
      name?: string | null,
      id?: string | null
    } | null | null,
    used_in_modules?: {
      plural_label?: string | null,
      api_name?: string | null,
      id?: string | null
    }[] | null,
    created_by?: {
      name?: string | null,
      id?: string | null
    } | null | null,
    presence?: boolean | null,
    customizable?: boolean | null,
    pick_list_values_sorted_lexically?: boolean | null,
    pick_list_values?: {
      type?: string | null,
      id?: string | null,
      sequence_number?: number | null,
      display_value?: string | null,
      reference_value?: string | null,
      actual_value?: string | null
    }[] | null
  }[] | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### list

`globalPicklists.list`

Get All Global Picklists. Fetches the list of global picklists available in the organization along with their details. pick_list_values, used_in_modules, and associated_fields_count can be included in the response based on the "include" query parameter.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.globalPicklists.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `include` | `(used_in_modules \| pick_list_values \| associated_fields_count)[]` | No | Comma-separated list of related resources to include. Allowed values: "used_in_modules", "pick_list_values", "associated_fields_count". Use CSV encoding (style=form, explode=false) for multiple values, e.g. include=used_in_modules,pick_list_values. |
| `include_inner_details` | `string` | No | Optional detailed expansion keys. Currently only allowed when `used_in_modules` is present in `include`. Allowed value: used_in_modules.plural_label. |
| `fields` | `string[]` | No | Comma-separated list of the api_names of the global picklist keys to be returned in the response, which lets you filter the response by key. Only the requested keys along with `id` are returned. Keys need not be unique — a key repeated in the list is processed once and the duplicates are ignored. Use CSV encoding (style=form, explode=false) for multiple values, e.g. fields=display_label,api_name,customizable. |
| `inner_details_filters` | `any` | No | JSON array used to filter the inner details returned for each global picklist in the list response. Each entry gives the inner resource in "api_name" and the criteria to apply in "filters", both of which are mandatory. Only "pick_list_values" is supported in "api_name", and within it only the "type" key can be filtered on, using the "equal" and "not_equal" comparators with the value "used" or "unused". "filters" takes either a single criteria using "field", "comparator" and "value", or a set of criteria in "group" combined using "group_operator", and a group may be nested inside another group. Use the "filters" query parameter instead to filter the global picklists themselves. |
| `filters` | `any` | No | JSON object used to filter the global picklists by the value of a key. Give either a single criteria using "field", "comparator" and "value", or a set of criteria in "group" combined using "group_operator". "group" and "group_operator" are mandatory to each other, and within a criteria "comparator" and "value" are dependent on "field". Only the "api_name", "source" and "customizable" keys can be filtered on; any other key returns a 400 with the code NOT_SUPPORTED. The string keys "api_name" and "source" support the "equal" and "not_equal" comparators with a string value, and the boolean key "customizable" supports only the "equal" comparator with a boolean value. Criteria cannot be nested inside another "group". |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  global_picklists?: {
    display_label?: string | null,
    source?: string | null,
    api_name?: string | null,
    created_time?: string | null | null,
    modified_time?: string | null | null,
    id?: string | null,
    actual_label?: string | null,
    description?: string | null | null,
    associated_fields_count?: number | null,
    modified_by?: {
      name?: string | null,
      id?: string | null
    } | null | null,
    used_in_modules?: {
      plural_label?: string | null,
      api_name?: string | null,
      id?: string | null
    }[] | null | null,
    created_by?: {
      name?: string | null,
      id?: string | null
    } | null | null,
    presence?: boolean | null,
    customizable?: boolean | null,
    pick_list_values_sorted_lexically?: boolean | null,
    pick_list_values?: {
      type?: string | null,
      id?: string | null,
      sequence_number?: number | null,
      display_value?: string | null,
      reference_value?: string | null,
      actual_value?: string | null
    }[] | null
  }[] | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

| `kiosks` | `object[]` | Yes | Contains the details for the kiosk to be cloned. |

### getExecution

### getRecordSteps.create

`kiosks.getRecordSteps.create`

Kiosk GetRecord. To create a GetRecords configuration associated with a Kiosk. It defines how records should be fetched from a module, including criteria, selection behavior, and sorting. Use the Get All Kiosks API to retrieve the Kiosk ID. Note: - You can configure GetRecords only for Kiosks in the draft state.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.kiosks.getRecordSteps.create({
	kioskId: 'example',
	get_records: [{
		criteria: {
			field: { api_name: 'example' },
			comparator: 'example',
			value: 'example',
		},

});
```

### getRecordSteps.delete

`kiosks.getRecordSteps.delete`

Kiosk GetRecord. To delete a specific GetRecords configuration associated with a Kiosk. Use the GetRecords Associations API to identify all associations of the GetRecords configuration. Remove the associations from the respective Kiosk components, and then delete the GetRecords configuration. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.kiosks.getRecordSteps.delete({ kioskId: 'example', getRecordId: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `kioskId` | `string` | Yes | Unique identifier of the kiosk. Use the [Get Kiosks API](kiosks.yaml#$.paths./settings/kiosks.get) to retrieve the Kiosk ID. |
| `getRecordId` | `string` | Yes | Unique identifier of the [GetRecord](kiosks_get_records.yaml#$.paths./settings/kiosks/&#123;kioskId&#125;/get_records/&#123;getRecordId&#125;.get) component. |

### list

`kiosks.list`

Get All Kiosks. To retrieve all the available Kiosks in your Zoho CRM organization. The response includes metadata for each Kiosk, such as version information, associated module, current status, creator and modifier details, and record context, if configured.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.kiosks.list({});
```

### listExecutions

`kiosks.listExecutions`

List kiosk executions. To retrieve all active executions for a specific kiosk in your Zoho CRM organization. For each execution, the response includes the user who ran the kiosk, the execution start and end times, the current or most recently visited state, and the transition available to execute next.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.kiosks.listExecutions({ kioskId: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `kioskId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the kiosk for which you want to perform the operation. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Page number for pagination. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Number of results per page. |
| `include_inner_details` | `string` | No | Specify additional inner details to include in the response. Accepts a comma-separated list of dot-notation paths indicating which nested properties should return extended information. |

### preview

`kiosks.preview`

Retrieve the Preview of a Specified Kiosk. Retrieves the configuration and details of the first screen state for a specified Kiosk in Zoho CRM. This API returns only the first screen data required to render the Kiosk and does not trigger any actions or require user interaction.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.kiosks.preview({ kioskId: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `current_record_id` | `string` | No | Specifies the ID of the record to use as the Current Record context while previewing the Kiosk. The record must belong to the module configured as the Current Record in the Kiosk. If this parameter is not provided, merge fields that reference the Current Record are not evaluated during the Kiosk preview and will return empty values. |
| `invoked_from` | `detail_view \| home_page \| cscript \| canvas` | No | Specify the context from which the kiosk preview is being invoked. Possible values: detail_view - The kiosk is invoked from the CRM record detail view. home_page - The Kiosk is invoked from the home page. cscript - The Kiosk is invoked from a Client Script. canvas - The Kiosk is invoked from a Canvas view. |
| `kioskId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the kiosk for which you want to perform the operation. |
| `include_inner_details` | `string` | No | Specify additional inner details to include in the response. Accepts a comma-separated list of dot-notation paths indicating which nested properties should return extended information. |

### states.create

`kiosks.states.create`

Create a kiosk state. Creates a state (screen, action, decision, or GetRecords) in a Kiosk identified by Kiosk ID. Only one state can be created per request. The Kiosk must be in draft status; use the Clone a Kiosk API if it is published or inactive.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.kiosks.states.create({
	kioskId: 'example',
	states: [{}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `kioskId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the Kiosk. |
| `states` | `(((any & any) & any) & any)[]` | Yes | Represents the array containing exactly one state object to create. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `states` | `object[] \| null` | No | Represents the array of operation result objects for the created kiosk states. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="states full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null,
    rid?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### states.delete

`kiosks.states.delete`

Delete a kiosk state. To delete a specific state from a kiosk configuration in your Zoho CRM account. Removing a state eliminates all its associated configurations, transitions, and connected elements. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.kiosks.states.delete({ kioskId: 'example', stateId: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `delete_dependent_states` | `string` | No | When a state is deleted, all its associated configurations, transitions, and connected elements are removed. Use the delete_dependent_states query parameter to control whether dependent/child states should also be deleted or left as disconnected components. The default value is true. Possible values: true false |
| `kioskId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the Kiosk. |
| `stateId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the kiosk state. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `states` | `object \| null` | No | Represents the operation result for a single kiosk state in a create or update response. Contains the result code, status, message, and state details. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="states full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null,
    rid?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### states.list

`kiosks.states.list`

Get all states of a kiosk. To retrieve all the states configured in a kiosk in your Zoho CRM organization, along with their transition details and basic metadata such as name, type, and associated fields. Each state represents a screen, action, decision, or GetRecords.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.kiosks.states.list({ kioskId: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `include` | `string` | No | Specify additional properties to be included in the response for each Kiosk state. By default, the response returns only the basic metadata of each state which includes each state's id, name, and associated_fields. **Possible values:** **configured_properties** - Includes the configured_properties key in the response for each state, which holds the list of merge fields and other dynamic references that have been configured within that state. When a state has no such configured properties, the value is returned as null. |
| `include_inner_details` | `string` | No | Specify to include additional inner details in the GET response for the kiosk state. |
| `kioskId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the Kiosk. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  states?: {
    associated_fields?: {
      api_name?: string | null,
      id?: string | null,
      type?: string | null
    }[] | null | null,
    name?: string | null,
    details?: {
      screen_details?: {
        width?: string | null,
        title?: string | null,
        button_align?: string | null
      } | null
    } | null | null,
    id?: string | null,
    type?: string | null,
    from_transition?: {
      name?: string | null,
      id?: string | null
    } | null | null,
    configured_properties?: {
      details?: {
        name?: string | null,
        component_name?: string | null
      } | null,
      type?: string | null
    }[] | null | null,
    transitions?: {
      name?: string | null,
      id?: string | null
    }[] | null | null
  }[] | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>


---

### states.update

`kiosks.states.update`

Kiosk State. To update a particular state in a specific Kiosk in Zoho CRM using the Kiosk ID and state ID. Each state represents a screen, action, decision, or GetRecords. A Kiosk must be in the draft status to update a state.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.kiosks.states.update({
	kioskId: 'example',
	stateId: 'example',
	states: [{}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `kioskId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the Kiosk. |
| `stateId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the kiosk state. |
| `states` | `(((any & any) & any) & any)[]` | Yes | Represents the array containing exactly one state object to update. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `states` | `object[] \| null` | No | Represents the array of operation result objects for the updated kiosk states. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="states full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null,
    rid?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### testRun

`kiosks.testRun`

Initiate a Test Run for a Kiosk. To initiate a test run for a kiosk before publishing it in your Zoho CRM organization. This operation executes all configured kiosk states and actions on live CRM data in real time. Runs the kiosk's actions on live records (emails, record changes); they are not undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.kiosks.testRun({
	kioskId: 'example',
	kiosk_test_run: [{}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `kioskId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the kiosk for which you want to perform the operation. |
| `kiosk_test_run` | `object[]` | Yes | Contains one or more test run entries, each providing the data context for initiating a kiosk test run. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="kiosk_test_run full type">

```ts
{
  data?: {
    Current_Record?: {
      id?: string | null
    },

  }
}[]
```

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `kiosk_test_run` | `object[] \| null` | No | Contains the result of the test run, including status, message, and details of the next executable state. |

<Accordion title="kiosk_test_run full type">

```ts
  code?: string | null,

      } | null

}[] | null
```

### update

`kiosks.update`

Update a Kiosk. To update an existing draft Kiosk in Zoho CRM. This API allows you to update the Kiosk's name, description, group API name, and current record module. Use the Get All Kiosks API to retrieve the Kiosk ID.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.kiosks.update({
	kioskId: 'example',
	kiosks: [{}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `kioskId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the kiosk. Use the [Get Kiosks API](kiosks.yaml#$.paths./settings/kiosks.get) to retrieve Kiosk ID. |
| `kiosks` | `object[]` | Yes | Contains the details of the kiosk to be updated. Although the field is an array, only one kiosk can be updated per request. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="kiosks full type">

```ts
{
  name?: string | null,
  group_api_name?: string | null,
  description?: string | null,
  current_record_module?: {
    api_name?: string | null,
    id?: string | null
  }
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `kiosks` | `object[] \| null` | No | Contains the list of kiosk result objects from the update operation. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="kiosks full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>

### updateAssociations

`kiosks.updateAssociations`

Kiosk Associations. This API allows you to associate an active Kiosk with the Record Detail View Page of a module. Once associated, the Kiosk will be available within the selected module's Record Detail View Page based on the specified layout. Use the Get All Kiosks API to retrieve the Kiosk ID.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.kiosks.updateAssociations({
	kioskId: 'example',
	kiosks: [{
		_associations: [{
			detail_view_page: [{
				layout: { id: '4876876000000333001' },
				module: {},
				name: 'example',
			}],
			type: 'example',
		}],
		id: '4876876000000333001',
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `kioskId` | `string` | Yes | Unique identifier of the kiosk. Use the [Get Kiosks API](kiosks.yaml#$.paths./settings/kiosks.get) to retrieve the Kiosk ID. |
| `kiosks` | `object[]` | Yes | Array of kiosk association configurations. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="kiosks full type">

```ts
{
  _associations: {
    type: string,
    detail_view_page: {
      layout: {
        id: string
      },
      name: string,
      _delete?: string | null,
      module: {
        name?: string | null,
        id?: string | null,
        api_name?: string | null
      }
    }[]
  }[],
  id: string
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `kiosks` | `object[] \| null` | No | Array of operation results. |

<Accordion title="kiosks full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```

</AccordionGroup>

## Layouts

### activate

`layouts.activate`

Activate Layout. Activates a single deactivated layout, making it available for use within the specified module. Optionally allows adding or removing profile associations during activation. Only one layout can be activated per request.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.layouts.activate({
	id: '4876876000000333001',
	module: 'Leads',
	layouts: [{ id: '4876876000000333001' }],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the layout to activate or deactivate. Refer to the [Get Layouts](layouts.yaml#$.paths./settings/layouts.get) resource for valid values. |
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module that contains the layout. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |
| `layouts` | `object[]` | Yes | Specify the array containing exactly one layout object to activate. The layout includes its unique identifier and optionally the profiles to associate or disassociate. Profile associations can be added (default) or removed (using _delete flag). The array must contain exactly one item. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="layouts full type">

```ts
{
  id: string,
  profiles?: {
    id: string,
    _delete?: boolean
  }[]
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `layouts` | `object[] \| null` | No | Array containing the result of the layout activation operation. Always returned in the response. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="layouts full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



---

### deactivate

`layouts.deactivate`

Deactivate Layout. Deactivates an active layout and transfers its configuration (profile associations, permissions, field mappings) to another active layout within the same module. At least one active layout must remain in the module. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.layouts.deactivate({ id: '4876876000000333001', module: 'Leads', transfer_to: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the layout to activate or deactivate. Refer to the [Get Layouts](layouts.yaml#$.paths./settings/layouts.get) resource for valid values. |
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module that contains the layout. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |
| `transfer_to` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of an active layout within the same module to which the deactivated layout's profile associations and configuration will be transferred. The target layout must be different from the layout being deactivated. Refer to the [Get Layouts](layouts.yaml#$.paths./settings/layouts.get) resource for valid values. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `layouts` | `object[] \| null` | No | Array containing the result of the layout deactivation operation. Always returned in the response. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="layouts full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



---

### delete

`layouts.delete`

Delete a custom layout. To delete a custom layout from a module in your Zoho CRM organization. When the layout being deleted has associated records, a target layout must be specified to receive the transferred records and profile associations. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.layouts.delete({ id: '4876876000000333001', module: 'Leads' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|

### get

`layouts.get`

Get layout by ID. To retrieve the details of a specific layout by its layout ID for a specified module in your Zoho CRM account. Important Notes: - The profiles array is null when the user does not have "Module Customization" permission in their profile.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.layouts.get({ id: '4876876000000333001', module: 'Leads' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the layout. Refer to the [Get Layouts](layouts.yaml#$.paths./settings/layouts.get) resource for valid values. |
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the required module. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |
| `mode` | `all \| business_card \| quick_create` | No | Specify the layout mode to filter the response. Available modes vary by module type. Possible values: `all` - Request all available layout modes. `business_card` - Business card layout view. `quick_create` - Quick create form layout. |
| `include` | `total_profiles \| portal_user_types` | No | Specify additional data to include in the response beyond the default layout structure. Possible values: `total_profiles` — include the total count of profiles associated with each layout. `portal_user_types` — include portal user type associations for each layout. |
| `include_inner_details` | `string` | No | Specify additional inner details to include in the response for each field. Possible values: `fields.allowed_permissions_to_update` - Include the set of permissions eligible for update per field. `fields.portal_user_types` - Include portal user type permission entries per field. |
| `include_element_types` | `field \| mirror_field` | No | Specify the type of field component in the layout, distinguishing standard fields from mirror fields that derive their value from a lookup source. Possible values: `field` — a standard data field in the layout. `mirror_field` — a field that reflects a value from a related module lookup. |



**Output:** `object`

### update

`layouts.update`

Update a custom layout. To update a custom layout in your Zoho CRM organization, including renaming it, modifying profile permissions, enabling or disabling the business card display, and creating, updating, or deleting sections and fields within sections.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.layouts.update({
	id: '4876876000000333001',
	module: 'Leads',
	layouts: [{}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the layout. Refer to the [Get Layouts](layouts.yaml#$.paths./settings/layouts.get) resource for valid values. |
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the required module. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |
| `layouts` | `object[]` | Yes | Contains exactly one layout object defining the update operations to be applied, including sections, profiles, and display settings. |

## Leads

### convert

`leads.convert`

Convert a Lead. Converts a Lead record into Contact, Account, and/or Deal records. Allows configuration of conversion behavior including overwrite settings, notifications, owner assignment, and tag carryover. The lead becomes a contact (and optionally an account and a deal) and is removed from Leads.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.leads.convert({
	leadId: 'example',
	data: [{}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `leadId` | `string` | Yes | Unique identifier of the Lead record to convert. Must be a valid Lead ID that exists in the CRM and has not been previously converted. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./module.get) to retrieve the lead ID. |
| `data` | `object[]` | Yes | Array of lead conversion configurations |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  overwrite?: boolean,
  default?: any,
  notify_lead_owner?: boolean,
  notify_new_entity_owner?: boolean,
  add_to_existing_record?: boolean,
  assign_to?: {
    id: string
  },
  Deals?: {
    Deal_Name: string,
    Campaign_Source?: string,
    Amount?: number,
    Contact_Role?: string,
    Pipeline: string,
    $move_attachments?: boolean,
    Stage: string,
    Closing_Date: string,
    Type?: string,
    Probability?: number | string,
    Lead_Source?: string,
    Next_Step?: string,
    Description?: string
  },
  carry_over_tags?: {
    Contacts?: {
    },
    Accounts?: {
    },
    Deals?: {
    }
  }
}[]
```

### getConversionOptions

`leads.getConversionOptions`

Lead Conversion Options. Retrieves available conversion options for a lead including matching contacts, accounts, field mappings, and layout preferences. This endpoint helps determine what conversion paths are available before performing the actual lead conversion.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.leads.getConversionOptions({ leadId: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `leadId` | `string` | Yes | The unique identifier of the Lead record (int64 as string) for which you want to retrieve conversion options. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./module.get) to retrieve the lead record ID. |
| `include_inner_details` | `string` | No | Fetches additional details of lookup or referenced inner resources within the same API call, avoiding separate dependent requests. Accepts a comma-separated list of inner resource paths starting from the root key of the response (the root key itself must not be included). Supports dot notation and JSONPath-style notation (e.g. $..key.sub_key). Invalid or non-permitted paths are silently ignored. |



**Output:** `object`

## Mail Merge

### download

`mailMerge.download`

Download mail merge document. To download the merged document created from a mail merge template for a specific record in your Zoho CRM organization. You can choose the output format as pdf, html, or docx, and optionally set a password for PDF documents.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.mailMerge.download({
	moduleApiName: 'Leads',
	recordId: 1,
	download_mail_merge: [{
		mail_merge_template: { name: 'example' },
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `moduleApiName` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the CRM module for which you want to perform the mail merge action. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |
| `recordId` | `number \| string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the record for which you want to perform the mail merge action. |
| `download_mail_merge` | `object[]` | Yes | Represents the list of download mail merge request objects. Contains one object per request. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="download_mail_merge full type">

```ts
{
  mail_merge_template: {
    name: string
  },
  output_format?: pdf | html | docx,
  file_name?: string
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `download_mail_merge` | `object[] \| null` | No | Represents the list of download mail merge response objects. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="download_mail_merge full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>

### send

`mailMerge.send`

Send mail merge email. To send a personalized email to one or more recipients using a mail merge template associated with a specific record in your Zoho CRM organization. You can include recipients in the To, CC, and BCC fields, and optionally attach the merged document either as an inline image or a separate file. Sends the merged document by email.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.mailMerge.send({
	moduleApiName: 'Leads',
```

## Mass Actions

### changeOwner

`massActions.changeOwner`

Submit mass change owner job. To bulk update the ownership of records in a specified module based on a Custom View, territory, or field-based criteria in your Zoho CRM organization. You cannot change the owner of related records using this API. You can change the owner of up to 50,000 records in a custom view.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.massActions.changeOwner({
	module: 'Leads',
	cvid: 'example',
	owner: { id: '4876876000000333001' },
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the CRM module. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |
| `cvid` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the Custom View whose records are to be reassigned. Refer to the [Get Custom Views](custom_views.yaml#$.paths./settings/custom_views.get) resource for valid values. |
| `owner` | `object` | Yes | Specify the details of the user to assign as the new owner of the selected records. |
| `territory` | `object` | No | Specify the territory to use as the source of records for the ownership change. |
| `criteria` | `object` | No | Specify the criteria to filter which records are included in the ownership change. |

```ts
}
```

```ts
  },

  value: string
}
```

### convertLeads

`massActions.convertLeads`

Submit mass convert job for leads. To submit a mass convert job that converts lead records into Contacts, Accounts, or Deals in your Zoho CRM organization. The job runs asynchronously and returns a job identifier for status tracking.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.massActions.convertLeads({
	ids: ['4876876000000333001'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | `string[]` | Yes | The record IDs of the leads you want to convert. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./&#123;module&#125;.get) to get the record IDs. Note that you can give a maximum of up to 50 records IDs in this array. |
| `Deals` | `object` | No | Must contain the mandatory keys "Deal_Name", "Stage", "Closing_Date", and "Pipeline"(if enabled), besides the other mandatory fields configured for the Deals module. Note that if there are layouts other than Standard, the custom-defined mandatory fields will not be processed while converting the lead. |
| `assign_to` | `object` | No | Specify the user to assign the converted records to. Refer to the [Get Users](users.yaml#$.paths./users.get) resource for valid values. |
| `portal_user_type` | `object` | No | Specify the portal user type for the contact created from the converted lead. Refer to the [Get Portal User Types](portal_user_type.yaml#$.paths./settings/portals/&#123;portal&#125;/user_type/users.get) resource for valid values. |
| `related_modules` | `object[]` | No | The API name and ID of the modules such as Tasks, Meetings, or Calls. If the lead has one or all of these related records, the owner of these records will be changed to the user given in the "assign_to" key. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to get the ID of the module. |
| `carry_over_tags` | `object[]` | No | The name and ID of the module you want to associate the tags to while converting the lead. For example, if you give contacts in this array, the tags of the lead will be carried over to the contact that the lead is converted to. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to get the ID of the module. Note that you can carry over tags to Contacts, Deals, and Accounts. |
| `move_attachments_to` | `object` | No | The name and ID of the module you want to move the attachments of the lead to after converting. Use the Modules API to get the ID of the module. Note that you can move the attachments to either Contacts, Deals, or Accounts. |
| `apply_assignment_threshold` | `boolean` | No | Specify whether assignment threshold rules should be applied when assigning the converted records. Possible values: **true** - Apply assignment threshold rules (default). **false** - Skip assignment threshold rules. |

```ts
}
```

```ts
}
```

```ts
}[]
```
</Accordion>

```ts
  id: string
}[]
```
</Accordion>

```ts
{
  api_name: string,
  id: string
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. **Deals** and **Meetings** are normalized internally to **Potentials** and **Events** respectively before the job's module is checked. |
| `job_id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the mass change owner job returned in the response of [Mass Change Owner API](mass_change_owner.yaml#$.paths./&#123;module&#125;/actions/mass_change_owner.post). |

### updateRecords

`massActions.updateRecords`

Mass update records. To update a specific field value across multiple records of a module in your Zoho CRM organization in a single API call. The operation supports two modes.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.massActions.updateRecords({
	module: 'Leads',
	data: [{}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `Leads \| Accounts \| Contacts \| Deals \| Campaigns \| Tasks \| Calls \| Meetings \| Cases \| Solutions \| Products \| Vendors \| Price_Books \| Quotes \| Sales_Orders \| Purchase_Orders \| Invoices \| Custom` | Yes | Specify the API name of the CRM module on which the mass update operation must be performed. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to fetch the valid API name of the module. |
| `data` | `object[]` | Yes | Specify the array of objects, where each object maps a field's API name to the new value to be applied across the targeted records. The key must be provided along with either `ids` or `cvid`. |
| `ids` | `string[]` | No | Specify the record IDs to be mass updated synchronously. Use `ids` for non-scheduler updates that target a small batch of records and require immediate processing. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./&#123;module&#125;.get) to get the valid IDs of the required records. &gt; **Note**: &gt; - You can use either **ids** key or the **cvid** key, you cannot use them both in a request. &gt; - Scheduler type(using record IDs): &gt; - You can mass update a maximum of 50,000 records in a single API call. &gt; - Automation rules are triggered automatically when the record count is less than 1000. When the record count is greater than 1000, automation rules do not get triggered. &gt; - If some of the records have invalid data, only those records will not be processed in the API call. &gt; - Non-scheduler type(using CVID and territory ID): &gt; - You can mass update a maximum of 500 records in a single API call. &gt; - Automation rules such as approvals, blueprints, and workflows are triggered automatically. &gt; - When you want to mass update records in a territory, you must specify the custom view ID. &gt; - You cannot mass update Email, lookup fields, layout fields, multi-line fields, and line items. &gt; - You can mass update up to three fields in the Deals module and only one field in all other modules in a single API call. |
| `cvid` | `string` | No | Specify the Custom View ID whose matching records must be mass updated. Use `cvid` to schedule an asynchronous background job that processes the records in the Custom View. Use the [Get Custom View API](custom_views.yaml#$.paths./settings/custom_views.get) to get the ID of the requires custom view. The response returns a `job_id` that can be passed to [Get Mass Update Status API](mass_update.yaml#$.paths./&#123;module&#125;/actions/mass_update.get) to track the progress of the scheduled job. &gt; **Note**: &gt; The cvid key is supported for mass update via API in the following editions: &gt; - Enterprise &gt; - Ultimate &gt; - CRM Plus &gt; - Zoho One Enterprise |
| `territory` | `object` | No | Specify the territory whose records must be mass updated. This key is valid only when you provide a Custom View ID in `cvid`. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
}[]
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="territory full type">

```ts
{
  id: string,
  include_child?: boolean
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  data?: {
    code?: string | null,
    details?: {
      job_id?: string | null
    } | {
      id?: string | null,
      Modified_Time?: string | null,
      Modified_By?: {
        id?: string | null,
        name?: string | null
      } | null,
      Created_By?: {
        id?: string | null,
        name?: string | null
      } | null,
      Created_Time?: string | null
    } | null,
    message?: string | null,
    status?: string | null
  }[] | null
} | {
  data?: any & any | null
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Meetings

### cancel

`meetings.cancel`

Cancel a Meeting. To cancel a meeting and send an email regarding the meeting cancellation to the participants. A meeting can only be cancelled if attendees have already been invited and the meeting has not passed its scheduled end time. With send_cancelling_mail, every participant gets a cancellation email.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.meetings.cancel({
	event: 'example',
	data: [{ send_cancelling_mail: true }],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `event` | `string` | Yes | This refers to the Event's id that need to be cancel |
| `data` | `object[]` | Yes | Array containing the cancellation notification preference. Mandatory. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  send_cancelling_mail: boolean,
  cancelled_by?: {
    id: string
  }
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | Array containing the cancellation result for the meeting. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null
}[] | null
```

### get

`modules.get`

Get module metadata by API name. Retrieves complete metadata for a specific CRM module identified by its API name, including fields, layouts, profiles, related lists, and feature capabilities. Returns 204 when the module is not available through this endpoint, or 400 when the identifier is invalid or the module is unsupported.

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.modules.get({ moduleIdentifier: 'example' });
```

| `include_inner_details` | `string` | No | Specify the nested field paths to include additional inner details in the module response. Accepts comma-separated values. Allows requesting extra metadata beyond the default module fields(for example fields.lookup.query_details.criteria.) |

### update

`modules.update`

Update Module Labels and Profiles. Updates the singular label, plural label, and profile assignments for the module identified by &#123;moduleIdentifier&#125;. Immutable fields such as access_type and api_name cannot be changed; attempting to include them returns a NOT_ALLOWED error.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.modules.update({
	moduleIdentifier: 'example',
	modules: [{
		singular_label: 'example',
		plural_label: 'example',
		id: '4876876000000333001',
		profiles: [{ id: '4876876000000333001' }],
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `moduleIdentifier` | `string \| string` | Yes | Specify the module identifier, either the numeric module ID or the module API name(case-sensitive). |
| `modules` | `object[]` | Yes | Single-element array containing the module object with the labels and profile assignments to update. Exactly one item is required. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="modules full type">

```ts
{
  singular_label: string,
  plural_label: string,
  id: string,
  profiles: {
    id: string
  }[]
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `modules` | `object[] \| null` | No | Single-element array containing the success result for the updated module. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="modules full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### updateMany

`modules.updateMany`

Update CRM modules. Updates existing modules in the CRM. Allows modification of module labels (singular_label, plural_label) and profile assignments. Supports batch updates of up to 100 modules per request. Returns 200 when all modules update successfully, or 207 Multi-Status when some succeed and others fail.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.modules.updateMany({
	modules: [{ id: '4876876000000333001' }],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `modules` | `object[]` | Yes | Array of module objects to update, with one to 100 unique entries. Each entry must include `id`; `singular_label`, `plural_label`, and `profiles` are optional. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="modules full type">

```ts
{
  singular_label?: string,
  plural_label?: string,
  id: string,
  profiles?: {
    id: string,
    _delete?: null
  }[]
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### getPhoto

`org.getPhoto`

Organization photo. To retrieve the organization photo for your Zoho CRM organization.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.org.getPhoto({});
```

**Input:** _empty object_


**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |

```ts
});
```

### users.invite

`portals.users.invite`

Invite portal users. To send a portal invitation to a single CRM record in your Zoho CRM organization, inviting or re-inviting the record as a portal user for the specified user type. Emails a portal invitation.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.portals.users.invite({
	module: 'Leads',
	recordId: 1,
	user_type_id: 'example',
	type: 'reinvite',
});
```

| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the CRM module for which you want to manage portal users. Refer to the [Get Modules](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/modules-api.html) resource for valid values. |
| `recordId` | `number \| string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the CRM record for which you want to perform the portal action. |
| `language` | `"" \| it_IT \| ru_RU \| pl_PL \| tr_TR \| hi_IN \| pt_BR \| th_TH \| fr_FR \| ja_JP \| in_ID \| cs_CZ \| de_DE \| hu_HU \| zh_TW \| es_ES \| nl_NL \| sv_SE \| da_DK \| bg_BG \| vi_VN \| iw_IL \| hr_HR \| en_GB \| ko_KR \| en_US \| zh_CN \| ar_EG \| pt_PT` | No | Preferred language for the invitation |
| `user_type_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the user type you want to assign this user with. Use the [Get User Types API](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/get-user-types.html) for this ID. |
| `type` | `reinvite \| invite` | Yes | Represents whether the user is invited the first time or is re-invited. The possible values are invite and reinvite. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `portal_invite` | `object[] \| null` | No | Represents the list of portal invitation response objects. Contains one object per invitation batch. |

<Accordion title="portal_invite full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    record_id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

`portals.userTypes.delete`


| `userTypeId` | `string` | Yes | Provide the unique numeric identifier of the portal user type to retrieve, update, or delete. |
| `transfer_To` | `string` | No | The ID of the portal user type to transfer existing users to before deleting. Required when the user type being deleted has active users assigned to it. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|

```ts
  } | null,
```

## Profiles

### clone

`profiles.clone`

Clone a CRM profile. Creates a new profile by cloning the existing profile identified by &#123;id&#125;. The request body must include the new profile's name, which must be unique within the organization and must not exceed 50 characters. See Create a Profile.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.profiles.clone({
	id: '4876876000000333001',
	profiles: [{ name: 'example' }],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Unique record identifier - a 64-bit integer encoded as a string of 1 to 19 decimal digits. |
| `profiles` | `object[]` | Yes | Single-item JSON array containing the new profile definition for the clone operation. |

<Accordion title="profiles full type">

```ts
{
  name: string,
  description?: string | null
}[]
```

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

`profiles.delete`

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

### list

`profiles.list`

Profiles. Retrieves the paginated list of all profiles in the organization, including each profile's name, type, permission details, and section groupings. Use the type query parameter to filter by profile type, and include_types to include Lite or Support profiles alongside the default set.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.profiles.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `type` | `private_profile \| normal_profile \| portal_profile` | No | Filters the returned profiles by profile type. Use `private_profile` to retrieve profiles used exclusively with team modules - private profiles are not allowed for normal custom modules, and non-private profiles are not allowed for team modules. **Possible values:** **`private_profile`**, **`normal_profile`**, **`portal_profile`**. |
| `include_types` | `string` | No | Comma-separated list of additional profile types to include alongside the default Administrator, Standard, and custom profiles. Accepted pattern: `(Lite\|Support)(,(Lite\|Support))*`. |
| `filters` | `any` | No | JSON-encoded filter criteria to narrow the profiles returned. Accepts a `Filters` object with `group` conditions and a `group_operator`. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Page number for paginated results. Defaults to 1. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Maximum number of profiles to return per page. Minimum 1, maximum 200. Defaults to 200. |

## Record Locking

### configurations.create

`recordLocking.configurations.create`

Create record locking configuration. Creates a new record locking configuration for the specified module. You can define locking rules, restricted actions, excluded fields, and other settings.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.recordLocking.configurations.create({
	module: 'Leads',
	record_locking_configurations: [{ lock_type: 'automatic' }],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | The API name of the module for which the record locking configuration is being managed. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve module names. |
| `record_locking_configurations` | `object[]` | Yes | Array containing the record locking configuration details to be created. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="record_locking_configurations full type">

```ts
{
  lock_type: automatic | manual | both,
  locked_for?: all_profiles | all_profiles_except_excluded_profiles,
  restricted_actions?: (change_owner | update | delete | tags)[],
  excluded_fields?: {
    id: string
  }[],
  feature_type?: string,
  locking_rules?: {
    name: string,
    lock_existing_records?: boolean,
    criteria: {
    }
  }[],
  restricted_communications?: string[],
  restricted_custom_buttons?: {
    id: string
  }[],
  lock_excluded_profiles?: {
    id: string

}[]
```

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

```ts
{
  status?: string | null,
  code?: string | null,
  message?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null
}[] | null
```

### changeOwner

`records.changeOwner`

Change Owner. To change the owner of a specific record in the specified CRM module in your Zoho CRM organization. Note: The module name Deals is accepted and internally resolved to Potentials. Meetings is internally resolved to Events.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.changeOwner({
	module: 'Leads',
	record: '4876876000000333001',
	owner: { id: '4876876000000333001' },
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module. |
| `record` | `string` | Yes | Specify the ID of the record for which you want to change the owner. |
| `owner_id` | `string` | No | Deprecated — use the `owner.id` field in the request body instead. |
| `owner` | `object` | Yes | Specify the details of the new owner for the record. |
| `notify` | `boolean \| null` | No | Specify whether to notify the new owner via email when the record is assigned.\\nPossible values:\\n**true** - The new owner is notified via email.\\n**false** - The new owner is not notified via email. |
| `related_modules` | `object[]` | No | Specify the related modules for which you want to transfer record ownership along with the main record. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="owner full type">

```ts
{
  id: string
}
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="related_modules full type">

```ts
{
  api_name?: Tasks | Events | Calls | Contacts | Deals,
  id?: string
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | Data containing the result of the owner change operation |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### changeOwnerMany

`records.changeOwnerMany`

Change Owner. Updates the owner of multiple records in the module. Note: The module name Deals is accepted and internally resolved to Potentials. Meetings is internally resolved to Events.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.changeOwnerMany({
	module: 'Leads',
	ids: ['4876876000000333001'],
	owner: { id: '4876876000000333001' },
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module. |
| `owner_id` | `string` | No | Deprecated — use the `owner.id` field in the request body instead. |
| `ids` | `string[]` | Yes | Specify the IDs of the records for which you want to change the owner. |
| `owner` | `object` | Yes | Specify the details of the new owner for the records. |
| `notify` | `boolean \| null` | No | Specify whether to notify the new owner via email when the records are assigned.\\nPossible values:\\n**true** - The new owner is notified via email.\\n**false** - The new owner is not notified via email. |
| `related_modules` | `object[]` | No | Specify the related modules for which you want to transfer record ownership along with the main record. |

### clone

`records.clone`

Record Clone. Clones a record in the specified module. Use the Get Modules API to retrieve the module ID and API name. Use the Get Fields Metadata API to retrieve the field IDs and API names. By default, the field values of the parent record are copied to the cloned record.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.clone({
	module: 'Leads',
	recordId: '4876876000000333001',
	data: [{}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module ID and API name. |
| `recordId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the record. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./module.get) to retrieve the record IDs. |
| `data` | `object[]` | Yes | Represents the data value. |
| `apply_feature_execution` | `object[]` | No | Use the "apply_feature_execution" array to trigger supported CRM features when creating or updating a record through the API. Specify "layout_rules" to apply layout rules or "criteria_validation_rule" to trigger validation rules. For "layout_rules", ensure the request includes all fields required by the layout rule criteria; otherwise, the API returns an error. For "criteria_validation_rule", all applicable validation rules are evaluated, and the API returns "MULTIPLE_OR_MULTI_ERRORS" if multiple rules fail. |
| `skip_feature_execution` | `object[]` | No | Use the "skip_feature_execution" array to skip Cadences execution when creating a record through the API. Specify "cadences" as the value of the "name" key and include this key alongside "data" in the request. |
| `trigger` | `(approval \| workflow \| blueprint \| pathfinder \| orchestration)[]` | No | Specifies the CRM features to execute for the API request. Supported values are "workflow", "approval", and "blueprint". If the "trigger" parameter is not specified, workflows, approvals, and blueprints related to the API are executed. Specify an empty array [] to prevent these features from executing. |

### count

`records.count`

Module Record Count. To retrieve the total number of records in a specified Zoho CRM module, optionally filtered by a Custom View or search criteria. The count can be filtered using cvid (Custom View ID) or search parameters (criteria, email, phone, or word).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.count({ moduleApiName: 'Leads' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `moduleApiName` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module for which you want to retrieve the record count. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |
| `email` | `string` | No | Specify an email address to filter the count to records that contain this value in any email field of the specified module. Encode special characters before submitting (for example, use `p%2Bboyle@abc.com` for `p+boyle@abc.com`). |
| `phone` | `string` | No | Specify a phone number to filter the count to records that contain this value in any phone field of the specified module. |
| `word` | `string` | No | Specify a search term to filter the count to records that contain this word in any searchable field within the specified module. |
| `cvid` | `string` | No | Specify the ID of the Custom View from which to retrieve the record count. Refer to the [Get Custom Views](custom_views.yaml#$.paths./settings/custom_views.get) resource for valid values. |
| `criteria` | `string` | No | Performs search by following the shown criteria: `(({api_name}:{operator}:{value}) and/or ({api_name}:{operator}:{value}))` Performs a search based on the following format: `(({field_API_name}:{operator}:{value}) and/or ({field_API_name}:{operator}:{value}))` Replace `{field_API_name}`, `{operator}`, and `{value}` with the appropriate field API name, condition, and value. **Key Points:** - You can search for a maximum of **10 criteria** (with same or different columns) - The only operator that is supported for **encrypted fields** is `equals` - When using the `equals` operator in the Search API, it behaves like `contains`, retrieving records that include the specified value **Single Condition:** If the condition is `(Company:equals:ABC)`, the response will include records with "ABC" as well as "ABC Inc" in the Company field. **Multiple Conditions:** `equals` still behaves like `contains`. For example, `((Company:equals:ABC) and (First_Name:starts_with:M))`, it retrieves records where the "First Name" starts with "M" and the "Company" contains "ABC" (e.g., "ABC" or "ABC Inc."). **Note:** The above behaviour does not apply to the **picklist field type**. **IN Operator:** The `in` operator checks if a field's value matches any value in a given list. For example, `(Full_Name:in:Patricia,Boyle,Kate)`, it retrieves records where the Full Name is Patricia, Boyle, or Kate. **Special Character Handling:** When a single-line field value contains characters such as `{`, `}`, `[`, `]`, `^`, `:`, `-`, `/`, `!`, `?`, `*`, `_`, `@`, space, the Search API returns records with similar-looking values, even if the characters are not an exact match. For example, if Record A has the field value `sales-team@zoho.com` and Record B has `sales_team@zoho.com`, a search using `equals:sales-team@zoho.com` may return both records. **Escaping Special Characters:** When using parentheses `()`, commas `,`, or a backslash `\\` as the last character in a search value, follow these steps: 1. Escape special characters using a backslash `\\` 2. Encode the value before making the API request. Select the value of the criteria, right-click the value, and choose the EncodeURIComponent option. **Example 1: Escaping Parentheses and Commas** - Search term: `((Last_Name:equals:Burns,B) and (First_Name:starts_with:M))` - Escape the comma `\\,`: `((Last_Name:equals:Burns\\,B) and (First_Name:starts_with:M))` - Encode the value: `((Last_Name:equals:Burns%5C%2CB) and (First_Name:starts_with:M))` **Example 2: Escaping a Backslash at the End** - Search term: `(Last_Name:equals:K\\)` - Escape the backslash `\\\\`: `(Last_Name:equals:K\\\\)` - Encode the value: `(Last_Name:equals:K%5C%5C)` **Supported Data Types:** `picklist`, `owner_lookup`, `user_lookup`, `lookup`, `phone`, `email`, `date`, `datetime`, `text`, `textarea`, `integer`, `currency`, `decimal`, `multiselectpicklist`, `bigint`, `percent`, `formula`, `website`, `boolean`, `double` **Supported Operators:** `equals`, `starts_with`, `in`, `not_equal`, `greater_equal`, `greater_than`, `less_equal`, `less_than`, `between` **Operator Compatibility by Data Type:** \| Data Type \| equals \| starts_with \| in \| not_equal \| greater_equal \| greater_than \| less_equal \| less_than \| between \| \|---\|:---:\|:---:\|:---:\|:---:\|:---:\|:---:\|:---:\|:---:\|:---:\| \| **text** \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| \| **textarea** \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| \| **email** \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| \| **phone** \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| \| **website** \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| \| **picklist** \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| \| **multiselectpicklist** \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| \| **lookup** \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| \| **owner_lookup** \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| \| **user_lookup** \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| \| **boolean** \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| ✗ \| \| **integer** \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| \| **bigint** \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| \| **currency** \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| \| **decimal** \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| \| **double** \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| \| **percent** \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| \| **date** \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| \| **datetime** \| ✓ \| ✗ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| \| **formula** \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| ✓ \| **Legend:** ✓ = Supported, ✗ = Not Supported **Note:** Refer to the Zoho CRM API documentation for the most up-to-date operator compatibility information. |
| `filters` | `object` | No | Represents the top-level filter criterion for data selection, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators. |
| `include_filters` | `string` | No | To include inner details of criteria and cross filters |
| `cross_filters` | `string` | No | Cross filter criteria for related module records |
| `converted` | `true \| false \| both` | No | Specify the conversion status to filter the count to lead records. This parameter is supported only for the **Leads** module. Possible values: **true** - Count only converted leads. **false** - Count only unconverted leads. **both** - Count leads regardless of conversion status. |
| `approved` | `true \| false \| both` | No | Specify the approval status to filter the count to lead records. This parameter is supported only for the **Leads** module. Possible values: **true** - Count only approved leads. **false** - Count only unapproved leads. **both** - Count leads regardless of approval status. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the page number to retrieve when paginating through results. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the number of records to include per page. |
| `type` | `AllUsers \| ActiveUsers \| DeactiveUsers \| ConfirmedUsers \| ConfirmedReportingUsers \| NotConfirmedUsers \| DeletedUsers \| ActiveConfirmedUsers \| AdminUsers \| ActiveConfirmedAdmins \| CurrentUser` | No | Specify the type of user records to count. This parameter is supported only for the **Users** module. Possible values: **AllUsers** - All users. **ActiveUsers** - Active users. **DeactiveUsers** - Deactivated users. **ConfirmedUsers** - Confirmed users. **ConfirmedReportingUsers** - Confirmed users with reporting access. **NotConfirmedUsers** - Unconfirmed users. **DeletedUsers** - Deleted users. **ActiveConfirmedUsers** - Active and confirmed users. **AdminUsers** - Users with administrator privileges. **ActiveConfirmedAdmins** - Active, confirmed users with administrator privileges. **CurrentUser** - The currently authenticated user. |

### create

`records.create`

Create records in a specified module. Creates one or more records in the specified module in your Zoho CRM organization. Use the Get Modules API to retrieve the module API name. Use the Get Fields Metadata API to retrieve the available field API names and data types. You can create up to 100 records in a single API call.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.create({
	module: 'Leads',
	data: [{ Last_Name: 'Rivera', Company: 'Northpeak' }],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module ID and API name. |
| `data` | `object[]` | Yes | Represents the data value. |
| `apply_feature_execution` | `object[]` | No | Use the "apply_feature_execution" array to trigger supported CRM features when creating or updating a record through the API. Specify "layout_rules" to apply layout rules or "criteria_validation_rule" to trigger validation rules. For "layout_rules", ensure the request includes all fields required by the layout rule criteria; otherwise, the API returns an error. For "criteria_validation_rule", all applicable validation rules are evaluated, and the API returns "MULTIPLE_OR_MULTI_ERRORS" if multiple rules fail. |
| `skip_feature_execution` | `object[]` | No | Use the "skip_feature_execution" array to skip Cadences execution when creating a record through the API. Specify "cadences" as the value of the "name" key and include this key alongside "data" in the request. |
| `trigger` | `(approval \| workflow \| blueprint \| pathfinder \| orchestration)[]` | No | Specifies the CRM features to execute for the API request. Supported values are "workflow", "approval", and "blueprint". If the "trigger" parameter is not specified, workflows, approvals, and blueprints related to the API are executed. Specify an empty array [] to prevent these features from executing. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  Layout?: {
    id: string
  },
  Wizard?: {
    id: string
  }
}[]
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="apply_feature_execution full type">

```ts
{
  name: layout_rules | range_validation | assignment_rules | function_validation_rule | criteria_validation_rule | global_map_dependency | territory_subordinates
}[]
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="skip_feature_execution full type">

```ts
{
  name: assignment_rules | cadences | connected_workflows
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  data?: {
    code?: string | null,
    message?: string | null,
    status?: string | null,
    details?: {
      id?: string | null,
      Modified_Time?: string | null,
      Created_Time?: string | null,
      Created_By?: {
        name?: string | null,
        id?: string | null
      } | null,

        id?: string | null
      } | null,
      $approval_state?: string | null,
      $state?: string | null,
      $wizard_connection_path?: string | null | null,
      $process_flow?: boolean | null,
```

### delete

`records.delete`

Delete a specific record by ID. To permanently delete a specific record by its unique ID from the specified module in your Zoho CRM organization. Use the Get Records API to retrieve the record IDs. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.delete({ module: 'Leads', recordId: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module ID and API name. |
| `recordId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the record. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./module.get) to retrieve the record IDs. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | Represents the data value. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### deleteMany

`records.deleteMany`

Delete records from a specified module. To permanently delete more records from the specified module in your Zoho CRM organization, use the Get Records API to retrieve the record IDs. A maximum of 100 records can be deleted per API call. By default, all workflows related to this API are executed. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.deleteMany({ module: 'Leads' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module ID and API name. |
| `ids` | `string[]` | No | Specify a comma-separated list of record IDs. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./module.get) to retrieve the record IDs. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  data?: {
    code?: string | null,
    details?: {
      id?: string | null
    } | null,
    message?: string | null,
    status?: string | null
  }[] | null
} | {
  data?: any & any | null
}
```

### deletePhoto

`records.deletePhoto`

Delete a record photo. To delete the photo associated with a specific record in your Zoho CRM organization. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.deletePhoto({ module: 'Leads', record: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module for which you want to manage the record photo. Refer to the [Get Modules Metadata API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module's API name. |
| `record` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the record for which you want to manage the photo. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./module.get) to retrieve the record IDs. |
| `restrict_triggers` | `string` | No | (Optional) Comma-separated list of automation triggers to suppress during the operation. Accepted values are `workflow`, `approval`, `blueprint`, `pathfinder`, and `orchestration`. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `code` | `string \| null` | No | Represents the success code for the photo delete operation. Possible values: **SUCCESS**. Example: "SUCCESS". |
| `message` | `string \| null` | No | Represents the success message describing the result of the delete operation. |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | Represents the status of the response. Possible values: **success**. Example: "success". |
| `details` | `object \| null` | No | Represents additional details about the delete operation. |

```ts
} | null
```
