### getFullData

`records.getFullData`

Rich text field content for a specific record. Retrieves the full content of rich text multi-line fields for a specific record identified by its record ID in the path. The 'fields' query parameter is optional for this endpoint - if omitted, all rich text fields of the record are returned.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.getFullData({ moduleApiName: 'Leads', id: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `moduleApiName` | `string` | Yes | The API name of the CRM module containing the record(s) whose rich text fields you want to retrieve (e.g., Leads, Contacts, Deals, Accounts). This is a mandatory path parameter. |
| `fields` | `string` | No | A comma-separated list of rich text field API names whose values you want to retrieve. Mandatory when retrieving rich text fields for multiple records (maximum 8 field API names). Optional when retrieving rich text fields for a specific record - if omitted, all rich text fields of the record are returned. |
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The unique identifier of the record whose rich text field content you want to retrieve. Must be a valid numeric record ID. If the ID is invalid, an INVALID_DATA error (HTTP 400) is returned. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  data?: {
    id?: string | null
  }[] | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### getFullDataMany

`records.getFullDataMany`

Rich text field content for multiple records. Retrieves the full content of rich text multi-line fields for multiple records in a single request. Both the 'ids' and 'fields' query parameters are mandatory. You can specify up to 200 record IDs in the 'ids' parameter and up to 8 rich text field API names in the 'fields' parameter.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.getFullDataMany({ moduleApiName: 'Leads', ids: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `moduleApiName` | `string` | Yes | The API name of the CRM module containing the record(s) whose rich text fields you want to retrieve (e.g., Leads, Contacts, Deals, Accounts). This is a mandatory path parameter. |
| `fields` | `string` | No | A comma-separated list of rich text field API names whose values you want to retrieve. Mandatory when retrieving rich text fields for multiple records (maximum 8 field API names). Optional when retrieving rich text fields for a specific record - if omitted, all rich text fields of the record are returned. |
| `ids` | `string` | Yes | Mandatory when retrieving rich text fields for multiple records. A comma-separated list of unique record IDs whose rich text field values you want to retrieve. You can specify up to 200 record IDs. Exceeding this limit results in an INVALID_REQUEST error. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  data?: {
    id?: string | null
  }[] | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### getMergeStatus

`records.getMergeStatus`

Get Merge Job Status. To retrieve the status of a scheduled merge job in your Zoho CRM organization. Use the optional job_id query parameter to filter results to a specific job.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.getMergeStatus({ masterRecordId: '4876876000000333001', module: 'Leads' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

| `masterRecordId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the master record to be retained after the merge operation. |
| `module` | `Accounts \| Contacts \| Leads \| Deals \| Cases \| Campaigns` | Yes | Specify the CRM module name containing the records to be merged. Possible values: **Accounts** - Accounts module. **Contacts** - Contacts module. **Leads** - Leads module. **Deals** - Deals module. **Vendors** - Cases module. Additionally, **custom modules** are also supported in this API. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  merge?: {
    job_id?: string | null,
    status?: string | null
  }[] | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```

</AccordionGroup>

### getPhoto

`records.getPhoto`

Get a record photo. To retrieve the photo associated with a specific record in your Zoho CRM organization.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.getPhoto({ module: 'Leads', record: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module for which you want to manage the record photo. Refer to the [Get Modules Metadata API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module's API name. |
| `record` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the record for which you want to manage the photo. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./module.get) to retrieve the record IDs. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `contentBase64` | `string` | No | The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set. |
| `text` | `string` | No | The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8. |
| `contentType` | `string` | Yes | Media type of the file, for example application/pdf. |
| `byteLength` | `number` | Yes | Size of the file in bytes. |
| `filename` | `string` | No | The file name, when known. |
| `contentOmitted` | `not_requested \| over_limit` | No | Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit. |
| `fileId` | `string` | No | Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text. |

### list

`records.list`

Get records from a specified module. Retrieves records from the specified module in your Zoho CRM organization. Use the Get Modules API to retrieve the module ID and API name. Use "sort_by" and "sort_order" to control the sorting of records. To fetch up to 2000 records, use "page" (1-10) and "per_page" (maximum 200). Pass fields (comma-separated API names, at most 50): Zoho requires it. Up to 200 records a page; page 1-10, then page_token from info.next_page_token for later pages. An empty module answers 204: &#123; success: true &#125;.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.list({ module: 'Leads', fields: 'Last_Name,Email,Company', per_page: 10 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module ID and API name. |
| `fields` | `string` | Yes | Specify a comma-separated list of field API names to include in the response. Use the [Get Fields Metadata API](fields.yaml#$.paths./settings/fields.get) to retrieve the field IDs and API names. |
| `territory_id` | `string` | No | Specify the unique ID of the territory. Use the [Get Territories API](territories.yaml#$.paths./settings/territories.get) to retrieve the territory ID. |
| `ids` | `string[]` | No | Specify a comma-separated list of record IDs. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./module.get) to retrieve the record IDs. |
| `cvid` | `string` | No | Specify the unique ID of the Custom View. Use the [Get Custom Views Metadata API](custom_views.yaml#$.paths./settings/custom_views.get) to retrieve the Custom View IDs. |
| `filters` | `object` | No | Represents the top-level filter criterion for data selection, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators. |
| `cross_filters` | `object[]` | No | Represents a list of cross-filter objects that filter Custom View records based on related module records' criteria. |
| `filterId` | `string` | No | The filter identifier |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the number of records to return per page. Maximum is 200. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the page number to retrieve. Starts at 1. |
| `page_token` | `string` | No | Specify the page token to retrieve records beyond the first 2,000 results. Use the **next_page_token** value from a previous response to access the next page of results. |
| `sort_order` | `desc \| asc` | No | Specify the sort order for the records.&lt;br/&gt; &lt;b&gt;Possible values:&lt;/b&gt; &lt;br/&gt;desc - Returns records in descending order.&lt;br/&gt; asc - Returns records in ascending order. |
| `sort_by` | `id \| Created_Time \| Modified_Time` | No | Specify the field to sort records by. Possible values:**id** - Sorts by record ID. **Created_Time** - Sorts by creation timestamp. **Modified_Time** - Sorts by last modification timestamp. |
| `converted` | `false \| true \| both` | No | Specify whether to retrieve converted, unconverted, or both types of records. Possible values:**false** - Returns only unconverted records. **true** - Returns only converted records. **both** - Returns both converted and unconverted records. |
| `include_child` | `boolean` | No | Specify whether to include records assigned to child territories of the specified territory. |

### listDeleted

`records.listDeleted`

Get deleted records from a specified module. To retrieve the list of deleted records from the specified module in your Zoho CRM organization, including records in the recycle bin and permanently deleted records. Use the Get Modules API to retrieve the module ID and API name.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.listDeleted({ module: 'Leads' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module ID and API name. |
| `type` | `all \| recycle \| permanent` | No | Specify the category of deleted records to retrieve. Possible values: **all** - Returns both recycled and permanently deleted records. **recycle** - Returns only records in the Recycle Bin. **permanent** - Returns only permanently deleted records. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the page number to retrieve. Starts at 1. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the number of records to return per page. Maximum is 200. |
| `ifModifiedSince` | `string` | No | Use this header to get the list of records modified after the specified timestamp. The timestamp must be in ISO 8601 format. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  data?: {
    id?: string | null,
    display_name?: string | null | null,
    type?: string | null,
    deleted_time?: string | null,
    deleted_by?: {
      name?: string | null,
      id?: string | null
    } | null | null,
    created_by?: {
      name?: string | null,
      id?: string | null
    } | null | null
  }[] | null,
  info?: {
    per_page?: number | null,
    count?: number | null,
    page?: number | null,
    more_records?: boolean | null
  } | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### merge

`records.merge`

Merge Records. To merge duplicate records in your Zoho CRM organization into a single master record. Supports field-level value selection from child records and file attachment management. The other records are merged into the master and deleted.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.merge({
	masterRecordId: '4876876000000333001',
	module: 'Leads',
	merge: [{
		data: [{ id: '4876876000000333001' }],
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `masterRecordId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifier of the master record to be retained after the merge operation. |
| `module` | `Accounts \| Contacts \| Leads \| Deals \| Cases \| Campaigns` | Yes | Specify the CRM module name containing the records to be merged. Possible values: **Accounts** - Accounts module. **Contacts** - Contacts module. **Leads** - Leads module. **Deals** - Deals module. **Vendors** - Cases module. Additionally, **custom modules** are also supported in this API. |
| `feature` | `string` | No | Triggers the web record approval flow instead of the standard merge flow. |
| `merge` | `object[]` | Yes | Specify the configurations for the merge. The array must contain exactly one object. |

<AccordionGroup>

```ts
        id: string
      }[] | null
    }[]
  }[],
  master_record_fields?: {
    api_name: string,
    _data?: {
      id: string
    }[] | null
  }[]
}[]
```

### search

`records.search`

Search Records by Criteria, Word, Email, or Phone. To search for records within a specified module in your Zoho CRM organization using criteria-based conditions, full-text word search, or lookup by email or phone number. Give one of criteria, email, phone or word. No match answers 204: &#123; success: true &#125;.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.search({ module: 'Leads' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module to search within. Refer to [Get Modules](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/modules-api.html) to retrieve a list of available modules. |
| `approval_state` | `approval_process_pending \| webform_invalid \| review_process_pending \| webform_invalid_approval \| zia_vision_validation \| review_process_rejected \| webform_unapproved \| email_parser_waiting \| approved \| merge_pending \| email_parser_rejected \| zia_vision_rejected \| zia_vision_pending \| approval_process_rejected \| webform_double_optin` | No | Specify the approval state to filter records by. The search returns only records in the specified approval state. Possible values: **approval_process_pending**, **webform_invalid**, **review_process_pending**, **webform_invalid_approval**, **zia_vision_validation**, **review_process_rejected**, **webform_unapproved**, **email_parser_waiting**, **approved**, **merge_pending**, **email_parser_rejected**, **zia_vision_rejected**, **zia_vision_pending**, **approval_process_rejected**, **webform_double_optin**. |
| `criteria` | `string` | No | Specify a criteria string to filter records using field-specific conditions and operators. Performs a search using the following format: `(({field_API_name}:{operator}:{value}) and/or ({field_API_name}:{operator}:{value}))` Replace `{field_API_name}`, `{operator}`, and `{value}` with the appropriate field API name, condition, and value. - You can search using a maximum of 10 criteria, with the same or different fields. - The only operator supported for encrypted fields is `equals`. When using the `equals` operator in the Search API, it behaves like `contains`, retrieving records that include the specified value. For a single condition, if the condition is: `(Company:equals:ABC)` the response includes records with `ABC` as well as `ABC Inc.` in the `Company` field. For multiple conditions, `equals` continues to behave like `contains`. **For example:** `((Company:equals:ABC) and (First_Name:starts_with:M))` This retrieves records where: - `First_Name` starts with `M` - `Company` contains `ABC` (for example, `ABC` or `ABC Inc.`) ** Note**: This behavior does not apply to picklist fields. The `in` operator checks whether a field value matches any value in a given list. **For example:** `(Full_Name:in:Patricia,Boyle,Kate)` This retrieves records where the `Full_Name` is `Patricia`, `Boyle`, or `Kate`. When a single-line field value contains characters such as: `{ } [ ] ^ : - / ! ? * _ @` or spaces, the Search API may return records with similar-looking values, even when the characters are not an exact match. For example: - Record A: `sales-team@zoho.com` - Record B: `sales_team@zoho.com` A search using: `equals:sales-team@zoho.com` may return both records. **Escaping Special Characters** When using parentheses `(` `)`, commas `,`, or a backslash `\\` as the last character in a search value: 1. Escape special characters using a backslash (`\\`). 2. Encode the value before making the API request. 3. Select the value of the criteria, right-click the value, and choose the `EncodeURIComponent` option. **Example 1: Escaping Parentheses and Commas** Search term: `((Last_Name:equals:Burns,B) and (First_Name:starts_with:M))` Escape the comma: `((Last_Name:equals:Burns\\,B) and (First_Name:starts_with:M))` Encode the value: `((Last_Name:equals:Burns%5C%2CB) and (First_Name:starts_with:M))` **Example 2: Escaping a Backslash at the End** Search term: `(Last_Name:equals:K\\)` Escape the backslash: `(Last_Name:equals:K\\\\)` Encode the value: `(Last_Name:equals:K%5C%5C)` **Supported Data Types** - `picklist` - `owner_lookup` - `user_lookup` - `lookup` - `phone` - `email` - `date` - `datetime` - `text` - `textarea` - `integer` - `currency` - `decimal` - `multiselectpicklist` - `bigint` - `percent` - `formula` - `website` - `boolean` - `double` **Supported Operators** - `equals` - `starts_with` - `in` - `not_equal` - `greater_equal` - `greater_than` - `less_equal` - `less_than` - `between` Refer to the following note for operator support by field type. * **Date, DateTime:** `equals`, `not_equal`, `greater_equal`, `greater_than`, `less_equal`, `less_than`, `between`, `in` * **Integer, Currency, Decimal:** `equals`, `not_equal`, `greater_equal`, `greater_than`, `less_equal`, `less_than`, `between`, `in` * **Boolean:** `equals`, `not_equal` * **textarea:** `equals`, `not_equal`, `starts_with` * **Lookup (user/owner):** `equals`, `not_equal`, `in` * **Picklist, Autonumber:** `equals`, `not_equal`, `in` * **Text, Email, Phone, Website:** `equals`, `not_equal`, `starts_with`, `in` * **multiselectpicklist:** `equals`, `not_equal`, `in`, `starts_with` * **bigint:** `equals`, `not_equal`, `greater_than`, `greater_equal`, `less_than`, `less_equal`, `between`, `in` * **percent:** `equals`, `not_equal`, `greater_than`, `greater_equal`, `less_than`, `less_equal`, `between`, `in` * **formula:** Operators depend on the formula return type. Check the corresponding data type's supported operators. |
| `converted` | `true \| false \| both` | No | Specify whether to filter records by their conversion status. Applicable only for the Leads module. Possible values: **true** - Returns only converted leads. **false** - Returns only unconverted leads. **both** - Returns all leads regardless of conversion status. Defaults to **false**. |
| `word` | `string` | No | Specify the word or phrase to search for across all searchable text fields in the module. The value must be at least two characters long. Performs a global search with minimum 2 characters required. This is the broadest search method but may be slower than specific field searches. *Mandatory if criteria, email, and phone are not present.* |
| `email` | `string` | No | Specify the email address to search for across all email-type fields in the module. Partial matches are supported and searches multiple email fields simultaneously. *Mandatory if criteria, phone, and word are not present.* |
| `phone` | `string` | No | Specify the phone number to search for across all phone-type fields in the module. The value must be at least three characters long and may include digits, spaces, hyphens, parentheses, and the plus sign. Supports various phone number formats including international, national, and partial numbers. *Mandatory if criteria, email, and word are not present.* |
| `fields` | `string` | No | Specify a comma-separated list of field API names to include in the response. If omitted, the response includes all fields accessible to the current user. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the page number to retrieve for paginated results. The minimum value is 1. Defaults to 1. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the number of records to return per page. The minimum value is 1, the maximum is 200, and the default is 200. |
| `sort_by` | `string` | No | Specify the API name of the field to sort the search results by. |
| `sort_order` | `asc \| desc` | No | Specify the direction in which to sort the results. Defaults to **desc**. Possible values: **asc** - Ascending order (A-Z, 1-9). **desc** - Descending order (Z-A, 9-1). |
| `type` | `ActiveAndDeactive \| CurrentUser \| DeletedUsers \| ParentRoleUsers \| ChildRoleUsers \| DeactiveUsers \| NotConfirmedUsers \| ConfirmedUsers \| ActiveUsers \| AdminUsers \| ActiveConfirmedAdmins \| ActiveConfirmedUsers \| DeveloperUsers \| SubordinateRoleUsers \| AllUsers \| AllActiveUsers` | No | Specify the user type to filter the search results by. Possible values: **ActiveAndDeactive**, **CurrentUser**, **DeletedUsers**, **ParentRoleUsers**, **ChildRoleUsers**, **DeactiveUsers**, **NotConfirmedUsers**, **ConfirmedUsers**, **ActiveUsers**, **AdminUsers**, **ActiveConfirmedAdmins**, **ActiveConfirmedUsers**, **DeveloperUsers**, **SubordinateRoleUsers**, **AllUsers**, **AllActiveUsers**. **Note** - Only one of the mandatory parameters (`criteria`, `email`, `phone`, or `word`) can be used in a single request. - If multiple parameters are provided, the API processes them in the following priority order: 1. `criteria` 2. `email` 3. `phone` 4. `word` - Only the highest-priority parameter in the request is processed. - The `page` and `per_page` parameters help retrieve records based on their position in Zoho CRM. - A single API call can fetch a maximum of 200 records. - To retrieve more records, adjust the `page` and `per_page` values. Example: To fetch 400 records: - First API call: `page=1&per_page=200` -&gt; Fetches records 1-200 - Second API call: `page=2&per_page=200` -&gt; Fetches records 201-400 By making two API calls, all 400 records can be retrieved. - The Search API allows you to search for and retrieve a maximum of 2,000 records. If the search exceeds 2,000 records, the API returns a `LIMIT_REACHED` error. - Values of fields containing sensitive health data are retrieved only when the **Restrict Data Access through API** option in the compliance settings is disabled. If the option is enabled, the field value is returned as `null`. Refer to [HIPAA compliance documentation](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/hipaa-compliance.html) for more details. - When you create or edit a record and search for it immediately, you may receive a `204 NO CONTENT` response due to indexing delays. To fetch records without delay, use the [Query API](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/Get-Records-through-COQL-Query.html). - The `in` operator supports up to 100 values. - The `full_name` field contains the concatenated values of the `First Name` and `Last Name` fields. - `full_name` is a read-only field available only in the `Leads`, `Contacts`, and `Users` modules. To retrieve subform records that match your search criteria, use the API name of the corresponding subform module. To retrieve multi-select lookup (MxN) records that match your search criteria, use the API name of the corresponding linking module. |
| `include_lite_users` | `boolean` | No | Indicates whether lite users should be included in the search results. |
| `role_id` | `string` | No | Filter users by role ID. This parameter is supported only for the Users module. |

### searchMany

`records.searchMany`

Bulk Search Records by Criteria, Word, Email, or Phone. Searches for records in the specified module that match the given search criteria. This API accepts the same search parameters as the GET /&#123;module&#125;/search API, but they are provided in the request body instead of query parameters.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.searchMany({ module: 'Leads' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module to search within. Refer to [Get Modules](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/modules-api.html) to retrieve a list of available modules. |
| `approval_state` | `approval_process_pending \| webform_invalid \| review_process_pending \| webform_invalid_approval \| zia_vision_validation \| review_process_rejected \| webform_unapproved \| email_parser_waiting \| approved \| merge_pending \| email_parser_rejected \| zia_vision_rejected \| zia_vision_pending \| approval_process_rejected \| webform_double_optin` | No | Specify the approval state to filter records by. The search returns only records in the specified approval state. Possible values: **approval_process_pending**, **webform_invalid**, **review_process_pending**, **webform_invalid_approval**, **zia_vision_validation**, **review_process_rejected**, **webform_unapproved**, **email_parser_waiting**, **approved**, **merge_pending**, **email_parser_rejected**, **zia_vision_rejected**, **zia_vision_pending**, **approval_process_rejected**, **webform_double_optin**. |
| `criteria` | `string` | No | Specify a criteria string to filter records using field-specific conditions and operators. Performs a search using the following format: `(({field_API_name}:{operator}:{value}) and/or ({field_API_name}:{operator}:{value}))` Replace `{field_API_name}`, `{operator}`, and `{value}` with the appropriate field API name, condition, and value. - You can search using a maximum of 10 criteria, with the same or different fields. - The only operator supported for encrypted fields is `equals`. When using the `equals` operator in the Search API, it behaves like `contains`, retrieving records that include the specified value. For a single condition, if the condition is: `(Company:equals:ABC)` the response includes records with `ABC` as well as `ABC Inc.` in the `Company` field. For multiple conditions, `equals` continues to behave like `contains`. **For example:** `((Company:equals:ABC) and (First_Name:starts_with:M))` This retrieves records where: - `First_Name` starts with `M` - `Company` contains `ABC` (for example, `ABC` or `ABC Inc.`) ** Note**: This behavior does not apply to picklist fields. The `in` operator checks whether a field value matches any value in a given list. **For example:** `(Full_Name:in:Patricia,Boyle,Kate)` This retrieves records where the `Full_Name` is `Patricia`, `Boyle`, or `Kate`. When a single-line field value contains characters such as: `{ } [ ] ^ : - / ! ? * _ @` or spaces, the Search API may return records with similar-looking values, even when the characters are not an exact match. For example: - Record A: `sales-team@zoho.com` - Record B: `sales_team@zoho.com` A search using: `equals:sales-team@zoho.com` may return both records. **Escaping Special Characters** When using parentheses `(` `)`, commas `,`, or a backslash `\\` as the last character in a search value: 1. Escape special characters using a backslash (`\\`). 2. Encode the value before making the API request. 3. Select the value of the criteria, right-click the value, and choose the `EncodeURIComponent` option. **Example 1: Escaping Parentheses and Commas** Search term: `((Last_Name:equals:Burns,B) and (First_Name:starts_with:M))` Escape the comma: `((Last_Name:equals:Burns\\,B) and (First_Name:starts_with:M))` Encode the value: `((Last_Name:equals:Burns%5C%2CB) and (First_Name:starts_with:M))` **Example 2: Escaping a Backslash at the End** Search term: `(Last_Name:equals:K\\)` Escape the backslash: `(Last_Name:equals:K\\\\)` Encode the value: `(Last_Name:equals:K%5C%5C)` **Supported Data Types** - `picklist` - `owner_lookup` - `user_lookup` - `lookup` - `phone` - `email` - `date` - `datetime` - `text` - `textarea` - `integer` - `currency` - `decimal` - `multiselectpicklist` - `bigint` - `percent` - `formula` - `website` - `boolean` - `double` **Supported Operators** - `equals` - `starts_with` - `in` - `not_equal` - `greater_equal` - `greater_than` - `less_equal` - `less_than` - `between` Refer to the following note for operator support by field type. * **Date, DateTime:** `equals`, `not_equal`, `greater_equal`, `greater_than`, `less_equal`, `less_than`, `between`, `in` * **Integer, Currency, Decimal:** `equals`, `not_equal`, `greater_equal`, `greater_than`, `less_equal`, `less_than`, `between`, `in` * **Boolean:** `equals`, `not_equal` * **textarea:** `equals`, `not_equal`, `starts_with` * **Lookup (user/owner):** `equals`, `not_equal`, `in` * **Picklist, Autonumber:** `equals`, `not_equal`, `in` * **Text, Email, Phone, Website:** `equals`, `not_equal`, `starts_with`, `in` * **multiselectpicklist:** `equals`, `not_equal`, `in`, `starts_with` * **bigint:** `equals`, `not_equal`, `greater_than`, `greater_equal`, `less_than`, `less_equal`, `between`, `in` * **percent:** `equals`, `not_equal`, `greater_than`, `greater_equal`, `less_than`, `less_equal`, `between`, `in` * **formula:** Operators depend on the formula return type. Check the corresponding data type's supported operators. |
| `converted` | `true \| false \| both` | No | Specify whether to filter records by their conversion status. Applicable only for the Leads module. Possible values: **true** - Returns only converted leads. **false** - Returns only unconverted leads. **both** - Returns all leads regardless of conversion status. Defaults to **false**. |
| `word` | `string` | No | Specify the word or phrase to search for across all searchable text fields in the module. The value must be at least two characters long. Performs a global search with minimum 2 characters required. This is the broadest search method but may be slower than specific field searches. *Mandatory if criteria, email, and phone are not present.* |
| `email` | `string` | No | Specify the email address to search for across all email-type fields in the module. Partial matches are supported and searches multiple email fields simultaneously. *Mandatory if criteria, phone, and word are not present.* |
| `phone` | `string` | No | Specify the phone number to search for across all phone-type fields in the module. The value must be at least three characters long and may include digits, spaces, hyphens, parentheses, and the plus sign. Supports various phone number formats including international, national, and partial numbers. *Mandatory if criteria, email, and word are not present.* |
| `fields` | `string` | No | Specify a comma-separated list of field API names to include in the response. If omitted, the response includes all fields accessible to the current user. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the page number to retrieve for paginated results. The minimum value is 1. Defaults to 1. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the number of records to return per page. The minimum value is 1, the maximum is 200, and the default is 200. |
| `sort_by` | `string` | No | Specify the API name of the field to sort the search results by. |
| `sort_order` | `asc \| desc` | No | Specify the direction in which to sort the results. Defaults to **desc**. Possible values: **asc** - Ascending order (A-Z, 1-9). **desc** - Descending order (Z-A, 9-1). |
| `type` | `ActiveAndDeactive \| CurrentUser \| DeletedUsers \| ParentRoleUsers \| ChildRoleUsers \| DeactiveUsers \| NotConfirmedUsers \| ConfirmedUsers \| ActiveUsers \| AdminUsers \| ActiveConfirmedAdmins \| ActiveConfirmedUsers \| DeveloperUsers \| SubordinateRoleUsers \| AllUsers \| AllActiveUsers` | No | Specify the user type to filter the search results by. Possible values: **ActiveAndDeactive**, **CurrentUser**, **DeletedUsers**, **ParentRoleUsers**, **ChildRoleUsers**, **DeactiveUsers**, **NotConfirmedUsers**, **ConfirmedUsers**, **ActiveUsers**, **AdminUsers**, **ActiveConfirmedAdmins**, **ActiveConfirmedUsers**, **DeveloperUsers**, **SubordinateRoleUsers**, **AllUsers**, **AllActiveUsers**. **Note** - Only one of the mandatory parameters (`criteria`, `email`, `phone`, or `word`) can be used in a single request. - If multiple parameters are provided, the API processes them in the following priority order: 1. `criteria` 2. `email` 3. `phone` 4. `word` - Only the highest-priority parameter in the request is processed. - The `page` and `per_page` parameters help retrieve records based on their position in Zoho CRM. - A single API call can fetch a maximum of 200 records. - To retrieve more records, adjust the `page` and `per_page` values. Example: To fetch 400 records: - First API call: `page=1&per_page=200` -&gt; Fetches records 1-200 - Second API call: `page=2&per_page=200` -&gt; Fetches records 201-400 By making two API calls, all 400 records can be retrieved. - The Search API allows you to search for and retrieve a maximum of 2,000 records. If the search exceeds 2,000 records, the API returns a `LIMIT_REACHED` error. - Values of fields containing sensitive health data are retrieved only when the **Restrict Data Access through API** option in the compliance settings is disabled. If the option is enabled, the field value is returned as `null`. Refer to [HIPAA compliance documentation](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/hipaa-compliance.html) for more details. - When you create or edit a record and search for it immediately, you may receive a `204 NO CONTENT` response due to indexing delays. To fetch records without delay, use the [Query API](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/Get-Records-through-COQL-Query.html). - The `in` operator supports up to 100 values. - The `full_name` field contains the concatenated values of the `First Name` and `Last Name` fields. - `full_name` is a read-only field available only in the `Leads`, `Contacts`, and `Users` modules. To retrieve subform records that match your search criteria, use the API name of the corresponding subform module. To retrieve multi-select lookup (MxN) records that match your search criteria, use the API name of the corresponding linking module. |

### update

`records.update`

Update a specific record by ID. To update the field values of a specific record in the specified module in your Zoho CRM organization. Use the Get Modules API to retrieve the module ID and API name. Use the Get Fields Metadata API to retrieve the field IDs and API names.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.update({
	module: 'Leads',
	recordId: '4876876000000333001',
	data: [{}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module ID and API name. |
| `recordId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the record. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./module.get) to retrieve the record IDs. |
| `data` | `object[]` | Yes | Represents the data value. |
| `apply_feature_execution` | `object[]` | No | Use the "apply_feature_execution" array to trigger supported CRM features when creating or updating a record through the API. Specify "layout_rules" to apply layout rules or "criteria_validation_rule" to trigger validation rules. For "layout_rules", ensure the request includes all fields required by the layout rule criteria; otherwise, the API returns an error. For "criteria_validation_rule", all applicable validation rules are evaluated, and the API returns "MULTIPLE_OR_MULTI_ERRORS" if multiple rules fail. |
| `skip_feature_execution` | `object[]` | No | Represents the skip feature execution value. |
| `trigger` | `(approval \| workflow \| blueprint \| pathfinder \| orchestration)[]` | No | Represents the trigger value. |

### upsert

`records.upsert`

Create or update records in a specified module. The Upsert API inserts a new record or updates an existing record based on duplicate check field values. If a matching record is found, it is updated; otherwise, a new record is inserted. When using the Upsert API, the system checks for duplicate records based on the duplicate check fields.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.records.upsert({
	module: 'Leads',
	data: [{}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module ID and API name. |
| `data` | `object[]` | Yes | List of records to be created or updated using the upsert operation. |
| `trigger` | `(approval \| workflow \| blueprint \| pathfinder \| orchestration)[]` | No | Specifies the CRM features to execute for the API request. Supported values are "workflow", "approval", and "blueprint". If the "trigger" parameter is not specified, workflows, approvals, and blueprints related to the API are executed. Specify an empty array [] to prevent these features from executing. |
| `duplicate_check_fields` | `string[]` | No | Specifies the fields used to check for duplicate records during an Upsert operation. Duplicate check fields can be system-defined unique fields or user-defined unique fields. The following are the system-defined duplicate check fields for the respective modules: Leads - "Email"; Accounts - "Account_Name"; Contacts - "Email"; Deals - "Deal_Name"; Campaigns - "Campaign_Name"; Cases - "Subject"; Solutions - "Solution_Title"; Products - "Product_Name"; Vendors - "Vendor_Name"; PriceBooks - "Price_Book_Name"; Quotes - "Subject"; SalesOrders - "Subject"; PurchaseOrders - "Subject"; Invoices - "Subject"; Custom Modules - "Name". If a matching record is found based on these fields, the record is updated; otherwise, a new record is inserted. |
| `wf_trigger` | `string \| null` | No | Workflow trigger identifier to be executed as part of the upsert operation. |
| `lar_id` | `string` | No | The unique ID of the assignment rule to trigger while inserting a record. Use the Get Assignment Rules API to retrieve valid values. This key must be provided parallel to the data key. Supported for all modules where assignment rules are applicable, such as Leads, Contacts, Deals, Accounts, Tasks, Cases, and Custom. |

## Record Sharing

### list

`recordSharing.list`

Share Records. To retrieve the share details of a specific record in a module of your Zoho CRM organization. The response lists each entry with the recipient, the access level, and the sharing metadata.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.recordSharing.list({ moduleApiName: 'Leads', recordId: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `moduleApiName` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module that owns the record. Refer to the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) for valid values. |
| `recordId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the record. Refer to the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./&#123;module&#125;.get) for valid values. |
| `sharedTo` | `string` | No | Specify the unique ID of the user whose share entries you want to retrieve. When set, the response returns only the share entries for that user. Use the [Get Users API](users.yaml#$paths./users.get) to get the valid IDs for the users. |
| `view` | `manage \| summary` | No | Specify the level of detail to include in the response. **Possible values**: summary, manage. |
| `approved` | `true \| false \| both` | No | Filters sharing records by approval status. - `true` - return only approved sharing entries - `false` - return only unapproved (pending) sharing entries - `both` - return all sharing entries regardless of approval status |
| `current_user` | `boolean` | No | Specify whether to return only the share entries for the current user. When set to **true**, the response returns only the share entries for the user making the API call. |



**Output:** `object`

### share

`recordSharing.share`

Share a record. To share a specific record in a module with one or more users, roles, or groups. A record can be shared with up to 10 users, 5 roles, and 5 groups. &gt; Note: &gt; - The records can be shared to other users in the organization only if certain conditions are met.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts

	moduleApiName: 'Leads',
	recordId: '4876876000000333001',
	share: [{

		permission: 'read_only',
		shared_with: { type: 'example', id: '4876876000000333001' },
	}],
});
```

## Related Records

### count

`relatedRecords.count`

Get related records count. To retrieve the count of related records for a specified parent record in your Zoho CRM organization. Supports optional filtering by approval status, conversion status, category type, and field-level equality criteria. A single request can include up to 20 related list count specifications.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.relatedRecords.count({
	moduleApiName: 'Leads',
	recordId: '4876876000000333001',
	get_related_records_count: [{
		related_list: { api_name: 'example', id: '4876876000000333001' },
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `moduleApiName` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the CRM module that contains the parent record. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module API name and its unique ID. |
| `recordId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the parent record for which you want to count related records. Use the [Get Records API](record.yaml#$.paths./module.get) to retrieve the record ID. |
| `get_related_records_count` | `object[]` | Yes | Represents the array of related list count request objects. Each object specifies a related list to query and optional filtering criteria to apply before counting. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="get_related_records_count full type">

```ts
{
  related_list: {
    api_name: string,
    id: string
  },
  params?: {
    approved?: boolean,
    filters: {
      comparator: string,
      field: {
        api_name: string
      },
      value: string
    },
    converted?: boolean,
    category?: link | files,
    approval_state?: string
  }
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### delink

`relatedRecords.delink`

Delink a related record. To delink a specific related record from a parent record in your Zoho CRM organization. This operation removes only the relationship link - the related record itself remains intact in its module. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.relatedRecords.delink({
	parentRecordModule: 'Leads',
	parentRecord: '4876876000000333001',
	relatedList: 'example',
	record: '4876876000000333001',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `parentRecordModule` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module the parent record belongs to. Refer to the [Get Modules](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/modules-api.html) resource for valid values. |
| `parentRecord` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique numeric identifier of the parent record. |
| `relatedList` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the related list containing the records to retrieve or modify. Refer to the [Get Related Lists](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/related-list-meta.html) resource for valid values. |
| `record` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique numeric identifier of the specific related record. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | Array of operation results per record. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null,
    api_name?: string | null,
    json_path?: string | null,
    param_name?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### delinkMany

`relatedRecords.delinkMany`

Delink related records. To delink multiple records from a parent record's related list in your Zoho CRM organization. This operation removes only the relationship links - the related records themselves remain intact in their respective modules. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.relatedRecords.delinkMany({
	parentRecordModule: 'Leads',
	parentRecord: '4876876000000333001',
	relatedList: 'example',
	ids: '4876876000000333001',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `parentRecordModule` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module the parent record belongs to. Refer to the [Get Modules](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/modules-api.html) resource for valid values. |
| `parentRecord` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique numeric identifier of the parent record. |
| `relatedList` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the related list containing the records to retrieve or modify. Refer to the [Get Related Lists](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/related-list-meta.html) resource for valid values. |
| `ids` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique identifiers of the records to delink from the parent record as a comma-separated list. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | Array of operation results per record. |

### get

`relatedRecords.get`

Get a related record. To retrieve the details of a specific related record from a specified related list of a parent record in your Zoho CRM organization.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.relatedRecords.get({
	parentRecordModule: 'Leads',
	parentRecord: '4876876000000333001',
	relatedList: 'example',
	record: '4876876000000333001',
	fields: 'Last_Name,Email',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `parentRecordModule` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module the parent record belongs to. Refer to the [Get Modules](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/modules-api.html) resource for valid values. |
| `parentRecord` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique numeric identifier of the parent record. |
| `relatedList` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the related list containing the records to retrieve or modify. Refer to the [Get Related Lists](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/related-list-meta.html) resource for valid values. |
| `record` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique numeric identifier of the specific related record. |
| `fields` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API names of the fields to include in the response as a comma-separated list. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>

```ts
{

} | {

}
```

### list

`relatedRecords.list`

Related Records. To retrieve the list of records associated with a parent record from a specified related list in your Zoho CRM organization.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.relatedRecords.list({
	parentRecordModule: 'Leads',
	parentRecord: '4876876000000333001',
	relatedList: 'example',
	fields: 'Last_Name,Email',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `parentRecordModule` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module the parent record belongs to. Refer to the [Get Modules](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/modules-api.html) resource for valid values. |
| `parentRecord` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique numeric identifier of the parent record. |
| `relatedList` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the related list containing the records to retrieve or modify. Refer to the [Get Related Lists](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/related-list-meta.html) resource for valid values. |
| `fields` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API names of the fields to include in the response as a comma-separated list. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the page number for paginating results. |
| `perPage` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the number of records to return per page. The page and per_page parameter is used to fetch records according to their position in the CRM. Let us assume that the user has to fetch 400 records. The maximum number of records that one can get for an API call is 200. So, for records above the 200th position, they cannot be fetched. By using the page (1 and 2) and per_page (200) parameter, the user can fetch all 400 records using 2 API calls. If the requested related list is not present or hidden in a layout, the system will return an INVALID_DATA response. |
| `ifModifiedSince` | `string` | No | Specify the date and time in RFC 2822 format. The response includes only records modified after this timestamp. |
| `page_token` | `string` | No | Specify the token to retrieve the next set of records beyond the first 2,000 results. Use the **next_page_token** value from the previous response. |
| `ids` | `string` | No | Specify the unique identifiers of the records to retrieve as a comma-separated list. |
| `sort_order` | `asc \| desc` | No | Specify the sort direction for the related records. Possible values: **asc**, **desc**. |
| `sort_by` | `id \| Created_Time \| Modified_Time` | No | Specify the field to sort the related records by. Possible values: **ID**, **Created_Time**, **Modified_Time**. |
| `converted` | `true \| false \| both` | No | Specify whether to filter records by conversion status. Possible values: **true**, **false**, **both**. |
| `approved` | `true \| false \| both` | No | Filter records by approval status. When set to true, returns only approved records; when false, returns only unapproved records. |
| `approval_state` | `webform_unapproved \| approved \| approval_process_pending \| approval_process_rejected \| webform_invalid \| webform_invalid_approval \| webform_double_optin \| review_process_pending \| review_process_rejected \| merge_pending \| zia_vision_pending \| zia_vision_rejected \| zia_vision_validation \| email_parser_waiting \| email_parser_rejected \| approval_process_recalled` | No | Filter records by their current approval state. |
| `filters` | `object` | No | Represents the top-level filter criterion for data selection, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators. |

### listDeleted

`relatedRecords.listDeleted`

List deleted related records. To retrieve the list of records that were previously associated with a parent record but have since been deleted from the related list in your Zoho CRM organization.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.relatedRecords.listDeleted({
	parentRecordModule: 'Leads',
	parentRecord: '4876876000000333001',
	relatedList: 'example',
	fields: 'Last_Name,Email',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `parentRecordModule` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the module the parent record belongs to. Refer to the [Get Modules](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/modules-api.html) resource for valid values. |
| `parentRecord` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique numeric identifier of the parent record. |
| `relatedList` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the related list containing the records to retrieve or modify. Refer to the [Get Related Lists](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/related-list-meta.html) resource for valid values. |
| `fields` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API names of the fields to include in the response as a comma-separated list. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the page number for paginating results. |
| `perPage` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the number of records to return per page. The page and per_page parameter is used to fetch records according to their position in the CRM. Let us assume that the user has to fetch 400 records. The maximum number of records that one can get for an API call is 200. So, for records above the 200th position, they cannot be fetched. By using the page (1 and 2) and per_page (200) parameter, the user can fetch all 400 records using 2 API calls. If the requested related list is not present or hidden in a layout, the system will return an INVALID_DATA response. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  data?: {
    id?: string | null,
    $member_info?: {
      id?: string | null,
      Created_Time?: string | null,
      Modified_Time?: string | null
    } | null,
    Moved_To__s?: string | null
  }[] | null,
  info?: {
    page?: number | null,
    per_page?: number | null,
    count?: number | null,
    more_records?: boolean | null,
    next_page_token?: string | null | null,
    page_token_expiry?: string | null | null,

  } | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```

### deactivate

`scoringRules.deactivate`

Deactivate a scoring rule. Deactivates an active scoring rule identified by ruleId, suspending its scoring evaluation without deleting it. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.scoringRules.deactivate({ ruleId: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ruleId` | `string` | Yes | Specifies the unique ID of the Scoring Rule to retrieve, update, activate, deactivate, delete, or clone. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `scoring_rules` | `object[] \| null` | No | Deactivation result for the scoring rule, containing the status and details of the deactivated rule. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="scoring_rules full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    unsaved_custom_fields?: {
      field_label?: string | null
    }[] | null,
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### delete

`scoringRules.delete`

Delete a scoring rules by ID. Permanently deletes a single scoring rule identified by ruleId. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.scoringRules.delete({ ruleId: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ruleId` | `string` | Yes | Specifies the unique ID of the Scoring Rule to retrieve, update, activate, deactivate, delete, or clone. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `scoring_rules` | `object[] \| null` | No | Deletion result for the scoring rule, containing the status and ID of the deleted rule. |

```ts
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```

### list

`scoringRules.list`

Scoring Rules. To retrieve a list of Scoring Rules configured in your Zoho CRM organization.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.scoringRules.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | No | Specifies the API name of the module to filter Scoring Rules by. |
| `layout_id` | `number` | No | Specifies the unique ID of the layout to filter Scoring Rules by. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specifies the page number for paginated results. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specifies the number of Scoring Rules to return per page. |
| `name` | `string` | No | Specifies the name of the Scoring Rule to filter by. |
| `fields` | `string` | No | Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. If this param is passed, except the mentioned fields, value of other fields will be null. Supported values: field_rules, signal_rules, name, description, active. |
| `active` | `boolean` | No | Filter rules by their active/inactive status. Pass 'true' to retrieve only active rules, 'false' for inactive rules. Omit to retrieve all rules regardless of status. |

## Service Preferences

### get

`servicePreferences.get`

Get service preferences. Retrieves the service preference settings of the organization, including whether the job sheet is enabled for service appointments. Use this API to check whether a job sheet can be generated once a service appointment is marked complete.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.servicePreferences.get({});
```

**Input:** _empty object_


**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  service_preferences?: {
    job_sheet_enabled?: boolean | null
  } | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>


---

### update

`servicePreferences.update`

Update service preferences. Updates the service preference settings of the organization. Use this API to enable or disable the job sheet, which controls whether a job sheet can be generated for a service appointment once the appointment is marked complete.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.servicePreferences.update({
	service_preferences: { job_sheet_enabled: true },
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `service_preferences` | `object` | Yes | Represents the service preference settings to update for the organization. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="service_preferences full type">

```ts
{
  job_sheet_enabled: boolean
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `service_preferences` | `object \| null` | No | Represents the result of updating the service preference settings of the organization. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="service_preferences full type">

```ts
{
  status?: string | null,
  code?: string | null,
  message?: string | null,
  details?: {
  } | null
} | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Services

### create

`services.create`

Create service records in Zoho CRM. To create one or more service records in your Zoho CRM organization, submitting up to 100 service objects per request, each configurable with a name, duration, price, location, members, availability type, and availability window.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.services.create({
	data: [{
		Availability_Type: 'Specific Day(s)',
		Duration: 1,
		Location: 'Business Address',
		Members: [{}],
		Price: 1,
		Service_Name: 'example',
	}],
});
```

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[]` | Yes | Specify the array of service objects to be created. You can include up to 100 objects. |

### delete

`services.delete`

Delete a service record by ID. To delete a service record from your Zoho CRM organization by its unique ID. When a service record is removed, all appointments associated with that service are also removed; however, deals created upon completion of an appointment under the service are not affected. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.services.delete({ id: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the service record to be deleted. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | Represents the per-record status array containing the result for each deleted service record. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    Modified_Time?: string | null,
    Modified_By?: {
      name?: string | null,
      id?: string | null
    } | null,
    Created_Time?: string | null,
    id?: string | null,
    Created_By?: {
      name?: string | null,
      id?: string | null
    } | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### list

`services.list`

Get services. To retrieve the list of service records in your Zoho CRM organization that match the specified filter criteria. Supports pagination using either the page or page_token parameter and can return up to 100,000 services across paginated requests.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.services.list({ fields: 'Last_Name,Email' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `fields` | `string` | Yes | Specify a comma-separated list of field API names to include in the response. Use the [Get Fields Metadata API](fields.yaml#$.paths./settings/fields.get) to retrieve the field IDs and API names. |
| `cvid` | `string` | No | Specify the unique ID of the Custom View. Use the [Get Custom Views Metadata API](custom_views.yaml#$.paths./settings/custom_views.get) to retrieve the Custom View IDs. |
| `page_token` | `string` | No | Specify the page token to retrieve records beyond the first 2,000 results. Use the **next_page_token** value from a previous response to access the next page of results. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the page number to retrieve. Starts at 1. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the number of records to return per page. Maximum is 200. |
| `sort_order` | `desc \| asc` | No | Specify the sort order for the records.&lt;br/&gt; &lt;b&gt;Possible values:&lt;/b&gt; &lt;br/&gt;desc - Returns records in descending order.&lt;br/&gt; asc - Returns records in ascending order. |
| `sort_by` | `id \| Created_Time \| Modified_Time` | No | Specify the field to sort records by. Possible values:**id** - Sorts by record ID. **Created_Time** - Sorts by creation timestamp. **Modified_Time** - Sorts by last modification timestamp. |



**Output:** `object`

## Tags

### addToRecord

`tags.addToRecord`

Add Tags to a Record. Adds tags to a specific record in the specified module.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.tags.addToRecord({
	module: 'Leads',
	id: '4876876000000333001',
	tags: [{}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | The API name of the module to perform the operation on. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the module API names. |
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Unique identifier of the record or tag. Use the [Get Tags API](tags.yaml#$.paths./settings/tags.get) to retrieve tag IDs. |
| `ids` | `string[]` | No | The ids of the records to tag (up to 500). |
| `over_write` | `boolean \| null` | No | If true, replaces all existing tags. If false, appends tags to existing ones. |
| `tags` | `object[]` | Yes | Array of tags to associate with the records (Required) |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="tags full type">

```ts
{
  name?: string | null,
  modified_time?: string | null,
  color_code?: string | null,
  conflict_id?: string | null
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | `string \| null` | No | Record IDs that were processed |
| `over_write` | `boolean \| null` | No | Indicates whether tags were replaced or appended |
| `data` | `object[] \| null` | No | Array of operation results for each record |
| `locked_count` | `string \| null` | No | Number of records that were locked and could not be updated |
| `success_count` | `string \| null` | No | Number of records that were successfully updated |
| `tags` | `string \| null` | No | Root key for tags |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="data full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    modifiedTime?: string | null,
    id?: string | null,
    affected_data?: null | null,

      name?: string | null,
      id?: string | null,
      color_code?: string | null | null,
```

### merge

`tags.merge`

Merge Tags. Merges two tags into one, combining their associated records and metadata. The tag specified in the path parameter (id) is the master tag that will remain after the merge. The conflict_id in the request body specifies the tag to be merged into the master tag.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.tags.merge({
	id: '4876876000000333001',
	tags: [{}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Unique identifier of the record or tag. Use the [Get Tags API](tags.yaml#$.paths./settings/tags.get) to retrieve tag IDs. |
| `tags` | `object[]` | Yes | Array containing the tag to merge (Required) |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="tags full type">

```ts
{
  name?: string | null,
  modified_time?: string | null,
  color_code?: string | null,
  conflict_id?: string | null
}[]
```

</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `tags` | `object[] \| null` | No | Array containing the merged tag details |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="tags full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    created_time?: string | null,

      name?: string | null,
      id?: string | null
    } | null,
    id?: string | null,
```

### delete

`territories.delete`

Delete a territory by ID. To delete a specific territory from your Zoho CRM organization using its unique ID. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.territories.delete({ id: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Represents the ID path parameter, which specifies the unique identifier of the territory. |
| `delete_previous_forecasts` | `boolean` | No | Represents the delete_previous_forecasts query parameter, which specifies whether to delete previous forecast data when transferring and deleting a territory. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `territories` | `object[] \| null` | No | Represents the list of territory objects deleted by the request. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="territories full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### deleteMany

`territories.deleteMany`

Delete territories. To delete one or more territories from your Zoho CRM organization. The territories to delete are specified using the ids query parameter. Deleting a territory is irreversible; child territories must be transferred before a parent territory can be deleted. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.territories.deleteMany({
	ids: ['4876876000000333001'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | `string[]` | Yes | Specify the unique IDs of the territories you want to delete. Accepts comma-separated territory IDs. |
| `delete_previous_forecasts` | `boolean` | No | Represents the delete_previous_forecasts query parameter, which specifies whether to delete previous forecast data when transferring and deleting a territory. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `territories` | `object[] \| null` | No | Represents the list of territory objects deleted by the request. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="territories full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```

### get

`territories.get`

Get territory by ID. To retrieve the details of a specific territory in your Zoho CRM organization using its unique ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.territories.get({ id: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Represents the ID path parameter, which specifies the unique identifier of the territory. |
| `include` | `account_rule_criteria \| lead_rule_criteria \| deal_rule_criteria \| account_rule_criteria,lead_rule_criteria \| account_rule_criteria,deal_rule_criteria \| lead_rule_criteria,deal_rule_criteria \| account_rule_criteria,lead_rule_criteria,deal_rule_criteria` | No | Represents the include query parameter, which specifies the rule criteria to include in the response. Possible values: **account_rule_criteria**, **lead_rule_criteria**, **deal_rule_criteria**, **account_rule_criteria,lead_rule_criteria**, **account_rule_criteria,deal_rule_criteria**, **lead_rule_criteria,deal_rule_criteria**, **account_rule_criteria,lead_rule_criteria,deal_rule_criteria**. |
| `include_inner_details` | `manager.zuid,manager.status \| manager.zuid \| manager.status` | No | Represents the include_inner_details query parameter, which specifies the additional manager fields to include in the response. Possible values: **manager.zuid,manager.status**, **manager.zuid**, **manager.status**. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

### listChildren

`territories.listChildren`

Get child territories by parent territory ID. To retrieve the list of child territories for a specific parent territory in your Zoho CRM organization.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.territories.listChildren({ id: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `include` | `account_rule_criteria \| lead_rule_criteria \| deal_rule_criteria \| account_rule_criteria,lead_rule_criteria \| account_rule_criteria,deal_rule_criteria \| lead_rule_criteria,deal_rule_criteria \| account_rule_criteria,lead_rule_criteria,deal_rule_criteria` | No | Represents the include query parameter, which specifies the rule criteria to include in the response. Possible values: **account_rule_criteria**, **lead_rule_criteria**, **deal_rule_criteria**, **account_rule_criteria,lead_rule_criteria**, **account_rule_criteria,deal_rule_criteria**, **lead_rule_criteria,deal_rule_criteria**, **account_rule_criteria,lead_rule_criteria,deal_rule_criteria**. |
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Represents the ID path parameter, which specifies the unique identifier of the territory. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Represents the page query parameter, which specifies the page number for paginated results. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Represents the per_page query parameter, which specifies the number of records to return per page. |
| `filters` | `object` | No | Represents the top-level filter criterion for data selection, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators. |
| `include_inner_details` | `manager.zuid,manager.status \| manager.zuid \| manager.status` | No | Represents the include_inner_details query parameter, which specifies the additional manager fields to include in the response. Possible values: **manager.zuid,manager.status**, **manager.zuid**, **manager.status**. |

### removeFromRecord

`territories.removeFromRecord`

Remove territories from a record. To remove one or more territories from a single record in your Zoho CRM organization. This operation is supported for records in the Leads, Accounts, Contacts, and Deals modules.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.territories.removeFromRecord({
	record: '4876876000000333001',
	module: 'Leads',
	data: [{
		Territories: [{ id: '4876876000000333001' }],
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `record` | `string` | Yes | Represents the record path parameter, which specifies the unique identifier of the record for the territory operation. |
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Represents the module path parameter, which specifies the API name of the module for the territory operation. |
| `data` | `object[]` | Yes | Specify the list of records and their associated territories to remove from the record. |

### removeFromRecords

`territories.removeFromRecords`

Remove territories from multiple records. To remove one or more territories from multiple records in your Zoho CRM organization. Supported modules are Leads, Accounts, Contacts, and Deals. The removal can be processed synchronously or scheduled as a background job, depending on the number of records.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.territories.removeFromRecords({
	module: 'Leads',
	data: [{
		id: '4876876000000333001',
		Territories: [{ id: '4876876000000333001' }],
	}],
});
```

### runRules

`territories.runRules`

Run territory assignment rules. To schedule territory assignment rules to run against records in a specified module in your Zoho CRM organization. The rules can be applied based on filter criteria, a Custom View, or specific territories, and the execution is queued as a background job.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.territories.runRules({
	run_rules: {
		module: 'Leads',
		based_on: 'example',
		criteria: {
			field: { api_name: 'example' },
			comparator: 'example',
			value: 'example',
		},
	},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `run_rules` | `object` | Yes | Specify the configuration for territory rule execution. The **run_rules** object must match one of three execution methods: criteria-based, Custom View-based, or territory-based. |

### transferAndDelete

`territories.transferAndDelete`

Transfer and delete a specific territory by ID. To transfer child territories to a target parent territory and then delete a specific territory from your Zoho CRM organization. This operation is required for territories that have child territories, as they cannot be directly deleted using the Delete Territories API.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.territories.transferAndDelete({
	id: '4876876000000333001',
	territories: [{ transfer_to_id: 'example' }],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Represents the ID path parameter, which specifies the unique identifier of the territory. |
| `territories` | `object[]` | Yes | Specify the transfer details for the territory to delete. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="territories full type">

```ts
{
  id?: string,
  transfer_to_id: string,
  delete_previous_forecasts?: boolean
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `territories` | `object[] \| null` | No | Represents the list of territory objects transferred and deleted by the request. |

```ts
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>
