## Timelines

### list

`timelines.list`

Get Timelines. To retrieve a paginated list of timeline entries for a specific record in your Zoho CRM organization. Each timeline entry captures an audited event such as field changes, ownership transfers, workflow actions, Approval Process progressions, Scoring Rule updates, and signal events from extensions.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.timelines.list({ module: 'Leads', recordId: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specifies the API name of the CRM module to retrieve timeline entries from. Use the value from the **api_name** field returned by [Get Modules](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/modules-api.html). |
| `recordId` | `string` | Yes | Specifies the unique ID of the CRM record to retrieve timeline entries for. |
| `include_inner_details` | `string` | No | Use this parameter if you want to retrieve additional details about updates made to a record in the `field_history` object of the response. **Possible Values** - field_history.data_type : Gives the data type of the field that was updated. - `field_history.field_label` : Gives the label details of the fields that were updated. - field_history.pick_list_values : Represents the list of values available for a picklist field. - `field_history.enable_colour_code` : Indicates whether colour coding is enabled for the picklist values. - `done_by.profile` : Provides details of the user's profile who updated the record. - `done_by.type__s` : Indicates the type of user (for example, portal user or regular user) who modified the record. |
| `page_token` | `string` | No | Specify the **next_page_token** or the **previous_page_token** after you have paginated and retrieved 200 records. Note that you cannot give **per_page** parameter if you give **page_token** in the request. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specifies the page number for retrieving timeline entries in paginated results. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specifies the number of timeline entries to return per page. The value must be **3**. |
| `filters` | `string` | No | **`filters` Parameter** The `filters` parameter is used to filter responses from the Timeline API based on specific conditions. Each filter condition consists of the following components: - field` - `comparator` - `value` **Supported `field.api_name` Values** The following values are supported for `field.api_name`: - `record.module.api_name` - `source` - `audited_time` - `done_by.id` **`record.module.api_name`** Use this field to filter timeline details related to the following record types: - `Notes` - `Attachments` - `Tasks` - `Calls` - `Events` - `Emails` **Allowed Comparators** - `equal` - `in` **Allowed Values** - `Notes` - `Attachments` - `Tasks` - `Calls` - `Events` - `Emails` **Example: Filter Notes** ```json { "field": { "api_name": "record.module.api_name" }, "comparator": "equal", "value": "Notes" } ``` **Example: Filter Notes and Tasks** ```json { "field": { "api_name": "record.module.api_name" }, "comparator": "in", "value": ["Notes", "Tasks"] } ``` **`done_by.id`** Use this field to filter timeline details performed by a specific user. **Allowed Comparators** - `equal` - `in` **Allowed Values** - User IDs **Example** ```json { "field": { "api_name": "done_by.id" }, "comparator": "in", "value": ["5843104000000424001"] } ``` **`audited_time`** Use this field to filter timeline data based on the audit timestamp. **Allowed Comparator** - `between` **Allowed Values** - Time in ISO 8601 format **Example: Filter Timeline Details Between Two Dates** ```json { "field": { "api_name": "audited_time" }, "comparator": "between", "value": [ "2023-10-25T00:00:00+12:00", "2023-10-30T23:59:59+12:00" ] } ``` **`source`** Use this field to filter timeline data based on its source. **Allowed Comparators** - `equal` - `in` **Allowed Values** - `crm_api` - `mass_delete_via_crm_api` - `bulkapi` - `approval_process` - `assignment_rules` - `blueprint` - `mass_update_via_blueprint` - `orchestration` - `convert` - `massconvert` - `custom_function` - `macro` - `crm_ui` - `mass_update` - `mass_update_via_scheduler` - `mass_delete_via_clean_up` - `bulk_action` - `change_owner` - `mass_change_owner_via_scheduler` - `review_process` - `scoringrule` - `wizard` - `workflow` **Example: Filter by a Single Source** ```json { "field": { "api_name": "source" }, "comparator": "equal", "value": "crm_ui" } ``` **Example: Filter by Multiple Sources** ```json { "field": { "api_name": "source" }, "comparator": "in", "value": ["crm_api", "crm_ui"] } ``` --- **Combining Multiple Conditions** Use `group_operator` and `group` to combine multiple filter conditions. **Example** ```json { "group_operator": "AND", "group": [ { "field": { "api_name": "record.module.api_name" }, "comparator": "in", "value": ["Notes"] }, { "field": { "api_name": "source" }, "comparator": "in", "value": ["crm_ui", "crm_api"] } ] } ``` You can also refer to the sample request for the complete structure. > **Note:** The value of the `filters` parameter must be URL-encoded before sending the request. **URL Encoding Example** The following filter: ```json { "comparator": "between", "field": { "api_name": "audited_time" }, "value": [ "2023-06-07T00:00:00+05:30", "2023-06-07T12:59:59+05:30" ] } ``` is encoded as: ```text filters=%7B%22comparator%22%3A%22between%22%2C%22field%22%3A%7B%22api_name%22%3A%22audited_time%22%7D%2C%22value%22%3A%5B%222023-06-07T00%3A00%3A00%2B05%3A30%22%2C%222023-06-07T12%3A59%3A59%2B05%3A30%22%5D%7D ``` You can use the **Encode URL** and **Decode URL** options in the [URL Encoder/Decoder tool](https://www.zoho.com/toolkit/encode-decode.html) to encode or decode this value. |
| `sort_by` | `string` | No | Specifies the field to sort timeline entries by. The only supported value is **audited_time**. |
| `sort_order` | `asc \| desc` | No | Specifies the sort order for timeline entries. Possible values: **asc**, **desc**. |
| `include_timeline_types` | `string` | No | To include extra types in the "timeline" object. You can get "signals" data through this to get signals-related timeline entries. |
| `include` | `string` | No | Use this parameter if you want to view the details of updates to the record through signals or any other means. The possible values are extension and type. For example, if the record was updated through a signal, then the response will have details of the extension as email insights, while the type of update will be signals. |

### delete

`users.delete`

Delete a user from the organization. To delete a specific user from your Zoho CRM organization, submit a DELETE request with the target user ID. Only one user can be removed per request, and certain protected user types — including support, system, Digital Employee, and primary contact users — cannot be deleted. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.users.delete({ user: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `user` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the user to retrieve, update, or delete. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `users` | `object[] \| null` | No | Represents the list of deletion results for the requested user. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="users full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### getTransferAndDeleteStatus

`users.getTransferAndDeleteStatus`

Get transfer and delete status. Retrieves the current status of a transfer and delete operation using the job ID returned by the POST request. The response indicates whether the job is scheduled, in progress, completed, or failed.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.users.getTransferAndDeleteStatus({ job_id: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `job_id` | `string` | Yes | Indicates the ID of the job scheduled previously through the [Transfer Records and Delete User API](users_transfer.yaml#$.paths./users/&#123;userId&#125;/actions/transfer_and_delete.post). |

### list

`users.list`

Get users. To retrieve all users in your Zoho CRM organization based on the specified filter parameters, including type, role, query criteria, and field selection.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.users.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `type` | `CurrentUser \| DeletedUsers \| DeactiveUsers \| NotConfirmedUsers \| ConfirmedUsers \| ActiveUsers \| AdminUsers \| ActiveConfirmedAdmins \| ActiveConfirmedUsers \| DeveloperUsers \| AllUsers \| AllActiveUsers \| ActiveLiteUser \| ActiveAndDeactive \| ChildRoleUsers \| ParentRoleUsers \| SubordinateRoleUsers \| ConfirmedReportingUsers` | No | Specify the type of users to retrieve. Possible values: CurrentUser - Retrieves the currently authenticated user. DeletedUsers - Retrieves only deleted users. DeactiveUsers - Retrieves only deactivated users. NotConfirmedUsers - Retrieves only unconfirmed users. ConfirmedUsers - Retrieves only confirmed users. ActiveUsers - Retrieves only active users. AdminUsers - Retrieves only administrator users. ActiveConfirmedAdmins - Retrieves active, confirmed, and administrator users. ActiveConfirmedUsers - Retrieves active and confirmed users. DeveloperUsers - Retrieves only developer users. AllUsers - Retrieves all users. AllActiveUsers - Retrieves all active users. ActiveLiteUser - Retrieves active lite users. ActiveAndDeactive - Retrieves both active and deactivated users. ChildRoleUsers - Retrieves users belonging to child roles. ParentRoleUsers - Retrieves users belonging to the parent role. SubordinateRoleUsers - Retrieves users in subordinate roles. ConfirmedReportingUsers - Retrieves confirmed users who have reporting relationships. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the page number to retrieve in the paginated response. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the number of user records to return per page. |
| `include_lite_users` | `boolean` | No | Specify whether to include lite users in the result set.\\n\\nPossible values:\\ntrue - Lite users are included.\\nfalse - Lite users are not included. |
| `role_id` | `string` | No | Specify the role ID to filter users. The API retrieves users with the specified role and higher or lower roles based on the value of the **type** parameter. Applicable only for **ParentRoleUsers**, **ChildRoleUsers**, and **SubordinateRoleUsers** types. |
| `query_id` | `string` | No | Specify the query ID of the user lookup field. Used to retrieve users based on the filter criteria of the lookup field. |
| `child_data` | `object` | No | Specify the child data object containing the record ID of the module with a user lookup field. This is required only if the user lookup field has criteria based on the dynamic value of a record. The **query_id** parameter is required when this parameter is provided. |
| `ids` | `string[]` | No | Specify a comma-separated list of user IDs to retrieve. If not provided, the API retrieves all users based on the other parameters. |
| `fields` | `string` | No | Specify the comma-separated list of field API names to include in the response. |
| `type__s` | `Regular User \| Sandbox Developer User \| Team User \| Digital Employee \| Support User \| Client Portal User` | No | Filter users by their account type. Possible values: **Regular User** - Standard CRM user with full access to the organization. **Sandbox Developer User** - User with access to the sandbox environment for development and testing. **Team User** - User operating as part of a team account. **Digital Employee** - Automated or bot-type user representing a digital workforce entity. **Support User** - User with access granted for support purposes. **Client Portal User** - User with limited access via the client-facing portal. |

### validateBeforeTransfer

`users.validateBeforeTransfer`

Validate user before transfer. Validates whether the specified user has open records, assignments, criteria configurations, subordinates, or alerts before transferring the user's data. Use this operation to check the user's dependencies before initiating a transfer.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.users.validateBeforeTransfer({ userId: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `userId` | `string` | Yes | Represents the unique identifier of the user whose data is to be transferred and whose account is to be deleted. Use the [Get Users API](users.yaml#$.paths./users.get) API to get the valid values. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  validate_before_transfer?: {
    id?: string | null,
    name?: string | null,
    assignment?: boolean | null,
    criteria?: boolean | null,
    subordinates?: boolean | null,
    alert?: boolean | null
  }[] | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Variable Groups

### generateApiName

`variableGroups.generateApiName`

Generate API Name. To generate an available API name for a new variable group in your Zoho CRM organization. Submit the proposed display name in the request, and the API returns a suggested api_name that complies with the naming requirements.

```ts
	variable_groups: [{ name: 'example' }],
```

## Variables

### create

`variables.create`

Create variables. Creates one or more CRM variables. The name, api_name, and variable_group keys are mandatory. The type key specifies the data type of the variable. Possible types: integer, text, percent, decimal, currency, date, datetime, email, phone, url, checkbox, textarea, long.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.variables.create({
	variables: [{
		api_name: 'example',
		name: 'example',
		type: 'text',
		variable_group: { id: '4876876000000333001' },
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `variables` | `object[]` | Yes | Array of variable definitions to create. Maximum: 25 items. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="variables full type">

```ts
{
  api_name: string,
  name: string,
  description?: string | null,
  type: text | integer | boolean | date | float,
  variable_group: {
    id: string
  },
  value?: string | number | boolean | null
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  variables?: {
    code?: string | null,
    details?: {
      id?: string | null,
      api_name?: string | null,
      json_path?: string | null
    } | null,
    message?: string | null,
    status?: string | null
  }[] | null
} | {
  variables?: {
    code?: string | null,
    details?: {
      id?: string | null,
      api_name?: string | null,
      json_path?: string | null
    } | null,
    message?: string | null,
    status?: string | null
  }[] | null
}
```
</Accordion>

### delete

`variables.delete`

Specific variable. Deletes a specific CRM variable identified by its ID. A variable that is associated with other features such as email templates, webhooks, or functions cannot be deleted until the association is removed. Requires the ZohoCRM.settings.variables.DELETE scope. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.variables.delete({ id: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The unique ID of the variable. Mandatory. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `variables` | `object[] \| null` | No | Array of operation results for each deleted variable. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="variables full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null,
    api_name?: string | null,
    json_path?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Webforms

### create

`webforms.create`

Create a new webform in Zoho CRM. To create a new webform in Zoho CRM with full configuration, including module assignment, layout, form fields, button attributes, analytics settings, double opt-in, spam control, visitor tracking, and portal form support. A single webform may be submitted per request.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.webforms.create({
	module: 'Leads',
	webforms: [{
		action_on_submit: 'splash_message',
		form_fields: [{ type: 'general' }],
		layout: {},
		location_url: ['https://example.com/callback'],
		module: { api_name: 'example', id: '4876876000000333001' },
		name: 'example',
		type: 'webform',
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the module API name of the CRM module for which the webform is being created or updated. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |
| `webforms` | `object[]` | Yes | Contains the list of webform configuration objects included in the request body. |

### delete

`webforms.delete`

Delete a webform by ID. To delete a specific webform from your Zoho CRM organization, send a DELETE request with the webform ID. The webform is permanently removed and the operation cannot be undone. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.webforms.delete({ id: '4876876000000333001', module: 'Leads' });
```

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique [Webform ID](webforms.yaml#$.paths./settings/webforms.get). |
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the module API name of the CRM module for which the webform is being created or updated. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `code` | `string \| null` | No | Represents the status code of the API response. Example: "SUCCESS". |
| `details` | `object \| null` | No | Represents additional details about the API response, such as the ID of the created or modified resource. |
| `message` | `string \| null` | No | Represents the response message describing the outcome of the operation. |
| `status` | `string \| null` | No | Represents the status of the API response. Possible values: success - The operation was successful. Example: "success". |

```ts
} | null
```

### deleteMany

`webforms.deleteMany`

Delete webforms by IDs. To delete multiple webforms from Zoho CRM, specify the IDs of the webforms to be removed. Note: - When multiple Webform IDs are passed, if some deletions succeed and others fail, the API responds with 207 Multi-Status. Check the status key in each response item to see the result of each deletion. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.webforms.deleteMany({ ids: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | `number` | Yes | Specify the comma-separated list of webform IDs for bulk delete or other bulk operations. Use the [Get Webforms API](webforms.yaml#$.paths./settings/webforms.get) to retrieve the webform IDs. |
| `trigger_source` | `string` | No | Specify the source that triggered the webform deletion. |
| `module` | `string` | No | Specify the module API name to filter webforms by the target CRM module. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |

```ts
    } | {
```

### list

### update

`webforms.update`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.webforms.update({
	id: '4876876000000333001',
	module: 'Leads',
	webforms: [{
```

## Webhooks

### create

`webhooks.create`

Webhooks. To create a webhook action that fires an HTTP request to an external URL in your Zoho CRM organization when an automation trigger fires. The http_method value controls which optional request fields are accepted.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.webhooks.create({
	webhooks: [{
		name: 'example',
		module: { api_name: 'example', id: '4876876000000333001' },
		url: 'https://example.com/article',
		http_method: 'POST',
		authentication: { type: 'general' },
		feature_type: 'workflow',
	}],
});
```

### delete

`webhooks.delete`

Delete a webhook by ID. To delete a specific webhook configured in your Zoho CRM organization using its unique ID. Read-only webhooks created by Marketplace extensions cannot be deleted. Webhooks associated with active Workflow Rules, Approval Processes, Blueprints, or Command Center also cannot be deleted. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.webhooks.delete({ webhookId: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `webhookId` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the webhook to delete. Refer to the [Get Webhooks](webhooks.yaml#$.paths./settings/automation/webhooks.get) resource for valid values. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `webhooks` | `object[] \| null` | No | Represents the list containing the operation result for the deleted webhook. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="webhooks full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



---

### deleteMany

`webhooks.deleteMany`

Delete one or more webhooks. To delete one or more webhook actions configured in your Zoho CRM account. Up to 10 webhooks can be deleted in a single API call using the ids query parameter. Read-only webhooks created by Zoho extensions cannot be deleted. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.webhooks.deleteMany({ ids: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | `string` | Yes | Specify the comma-separated list of webhook IDs to delete. Accepts comma-separated values. Refer to the [Get Webhooks](webhooks.yaml#$.paths./settings/automation/webhooks.get) resource for valid values. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  webhooks?: {
    code?: string | null,
    details?: {
      id?: string | null
    } | null,
    message?: string | null,
    status?: string | null
  }[] | null
} | {
  webhooks?: {
    code?: string | null,
    details?: {
      id?: string | null
    } | null,
    message?: string | null,
    status?: string | null
  }[] | null
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### getFailures

`webhooks.getFailures`

Get webhook execution failure records. To retrieve detailed information about webhook execution failures in your Zoho CRM organization. Optionally filter results by module, webhook ID, and date range. If the from and to parameters are not specified, the API returns webhook failures from the last 30 days by default.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.webhooks.getFailures({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `webhook_id` | `string` | No | Specify the unique identifier of the webhook whose failure records to retrieve. Refer to the [Get Webhooks](webhooks.yaml#$.paths./settings/automation/webhooks.get) resource for valid values. When omitted, failure records for all webhooks are returned. |
| `module` | `string` | No | Specify the API name of the parent CRM module to filter webhooks. When omitted, webhooks across all modules are returned. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |
| `from` | `string` | No | Specify the start date (inclusive) for the query window in YYYY-MM-DD format, evaluated in the organization's time zone. For webhook_failures, defaults to 30 days before **to**; earlier dates are clamped to that 30-day window. For usage_reports, defaults to 30 days before **to**. Future dates return 400 INVALID_DATA. |
| `to` | `string` | No | Specify the end date (inclusive) for the query window in YYYY-MM-DD format, evaluated in the organization's time zone. Defaults to the current date at 23:59:59 when omitted. Must be on or after the **from** date. Future dates are rejected. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the page number for paginated results. Defaults to 1 when omitted. Use together with per_page to navigate large result sets. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the number of records to return per page. Default and maximum is **200**. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  webhook_failures?: {
    webhook?: {
      name?: string | null,
      id?: string | null
    } | null,
    entity_details?: {
      module?: {
        api_name?: string | null,
        id?: string | null
      } | null,
      name?: string | null,
      id?: string | null
    } | null,
    failure_time?: string | null,
    failure_reason?: string | null,
    id?: string | null,
    workflow_rule?: {
      name?: string | null,
      id?: string | null
    } | null
  }[] | null,
  info?: {
    max_limit?: number | null,
    per_page?: number | null,
    count?: number | null,
    page?: number | null,
    more_records?: boolean | null
  } | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### getUsageReports

`webhooks.getUsageReports`

Get webhook action usage reports. To retrieve usage statistics for webhook actions executed in your Zoho CRM organization. Specify the group_by parameter to control the granularity of results; optionally filter by automation feature type and date range.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.webhooks.getUsageReports({ group_by: 'date' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `group_by` | `date \| date,resource \| date,resource,type` | Yes | Specify the grouping criteria for usage data. Must include date. Possible values: **date** - Returns daily totals; the resource object is omitted from each row. **date,resource** - Returns per-action rows including resource.id and resource.name. **date,resource,type** - Returns per-action rows grouped by resource and type. |
| `type` | `workflow_rules \| approval_process \| blueprint \| orchestrations \| wizards \| modules \| webhooks \| kiosks` | No | Specify the automation feature type to filter usage data. When omitted, usage across all supported feature types is returned. Possible values: **workflow_rules** - Workflow Rules. **approval_process** - Approval Process. **blueprint** - Blueprint. **orchestrations** - Orchestrations. **wizards** - Wizards. **modules** - Modules. **webhooks** - Webhooks. **kiosks** - Kiosks. |
| `from` | `string` | No | Specify the start date (inclusive) for the query window in YYYY-MM-DD format, evaluated in the organization's time zone. For webhook_failures, defaults to 30 days before **to**; earlier dates are clamped to that 30-day window. For usage_reports, defaults to 30 days before **to**. Future dates return 400 INVALID_DATA. |
| `to` | `string` | No | Specify the end date (inclusive) for the query window in YYYY-MM-DD format, evaluated in the organization's time zone. Defaults to the current date at 23:59:59 when omitted. Must be on or after the **from** date. Future dates are rejected. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the page number for paginated results. Defaults to 1 when omitted. Use together with per_page to navigate large result sets. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the number of records to return per page. Default and maximum is **200**. |
| `sort_order` | `asc \| desc` | No | Specify the sort direction for list results. Defaults to desc when omitted. Possible values: **asc** - Ascending order. **desc** - Descending order. |
| `include_inner_details` | `string` | No | Specify to request additional nested fields within usage report resource objects. Currently, only resource.layout_id is recognized; it adds layout_id inside the resource object when available, primarily for wizard usage rows. Other values are silently ignored. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  data_usage?: {
    date?: string | null,
    resource?: {
      id?: string | null,
      name?: string | null,
      layout_id?: string | null
    } | null,
    count?: number | null,
    type?: string | null
  }[] | null,
  info?: {
    per_page?: number | null,
    count?: number | null,
    page?: number | null,
    more_records?: boolean | null,
    max_limit?: number | null
  } | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### list

`webhooks.list`

Get webhooks. To retrieve the list of all webhook action configurations available in your Zoho CRM organization. The response contains summary-level data for each webhook, including the module, URL, HTTP method, feature type, and audit metadata.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.webhooks.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | No | Specify the API name of the parent CRM module to filter webhooks. When omitted, webhooks across all modules are returned. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the page number for paginated results. Defaults to 1 when omitted. Use together with per_page to navigate large result sets. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the number of records to return per page. Default and maximum is **200**. |
| `sort_by` | `string` | No | Specify the field used to sort the webhook list. Currently only Modified_Time is accepted. Possible values: **Modified_Time** - Sort by the last modified timestamp. |
| `sort_order` | `asc \| desc` | No | Specify the sort direction for list results. Defaults to desc when omitted. Possible values: **asc** - Ascending order. **desc** - Descending order. |
| `feature_type` | `workflow \| approval_process \| blueprint_transition \| blueprint_state \| assignment_rules \| kiosk \| commandcenter_service` | No | Specify the automation feature type to filter webhooks. When omitted, webhooks of all feature types are returned. Possible values: **workflow** - Workflow Rule. **approval_process** - Approval Process. **blueprint_transition** - Blueprint transition. **blueprint_state** - Blueprint state. **assignment_rules** - Assignment Rules. **kiosk** - Kiosk feature. **commandcenter_service** - CommandCenter service. |
| `related_module` | `string` | No | Specify the API name of a child or dependent module linked to the parent module (for example, Notes or Attachments). When omitted, webhooks across all related modules are returned. |
| `filters` | `string` | No | Specify the JSON filter expression to narrow webhook results by name. The object must include field (with api_name), comparator, and value keys. The only supported comparator is contains, which performs a case-insensitive partial match on the webhook name. |

### get

`wizards.get`

Get wizard details. To retrieve the complete configuration of a single wizard in your Zoho CRM organization, including its containers, screens, segments, buttons, and conditional rules.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.wizards.get({ id: '4876876000000333001', layout_id: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the wizard to retrieve or delete. |
| `layout_id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the layout associated with the wizard. Refer to the [Get Layouts](layouts.yaml#$.paths./settings/layouts.get) resource for valid values. |



**Output:** `object`

### list

`wizards.list`

Get all wizard configurations. To retrieve the wizard configurations available in your Zoho CRM organization. The response can be filtered by module using the module query parameter.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.wizards.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | No | Specify the API name of the module for which you want to retrieve wizards. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |



**Output:** `object`

### update

`wizards.update`

Wizard. Updates the specified wizard including screens, containers, field configurations, and rules - based on the data provided in the request.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.wizards.update({
	id: '4876876000000333001',
	wizards: [{}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Specify the unique ID of the wizard to retrieve or delete. |
| `wizards` | `object[]` | Yes | List of wizard definitions to be updated. Only one wizard can be updated per request. |

## Workflow Rules

### create

`workflowRules.create`

Create a workflow rule for a module. To create a workflow rule for a specified module in your Zoho CRM organization. Each request accepts exactly one rule, defined within the workflow_rules array.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.workflowRules.create({
	workflow_rules: [{
		conditions: [{ sequence_number: 1 }],
		execute_when: { type: 'create' },
		module: { api_name: 'example', id: '4876876000000333001' },
		name: 'example',
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `workflow_rules` | `object[]` | Yes | Represents the array containing the workflow rule object to create. The array must contain exactly one object per request. |

### delete

`workflowRules.delete`

Delete a workflow rule by ID. To delete a workflow rule from your Zoho CRM organization by its unique ID. Locked workflow rules cannot be deleted. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.workflowRules.delete({ id: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Represents the unique 19-digit numeric ID of the workflow rule. Obtain valid IDs from the List Workflow Rules endpoint. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `workflow_rules` | `object[] \| null` | No | Represents the array of workflow rule objects returned in the success response. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="workflow_rules full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### deleteMany

`workflowRules.deleteMany`

Delete One or More Workflow Rules. To delete one or more workflow rules from your Zoho CRM organization. You can delete up to ten workflow rules in a single API call; when some deletions succeed and others fail, the API responds with a 207 Multi-Status. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.workflowRules.deleteMany({ ids: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | `string` | Yes | Specifies one or more workflow rule IDs to filter the results. Provide multiple IDs as comma-separated values. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  workflow_rules?: {
    code?: string | null,
    details?: {
      id?: string | null
    } | null,
    message?: string | null,
    status?: string | null
  }[] | null
} | {
```

### get

`workflowRules.get`

Retrieve Workflow Rule by ID. To retrieve the complete configuration of a specific workflow rule in your Zoho CRM organization, including its trigger type, execution criteria, conditions, instant actions, scheduled actions, and lock status.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.workflowRules.get({ id: '4876876000000333001' });
```

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Represents the unique 19-digit numeric ID of the workflow rule. Obtain valid IDs from the List Workflow Rules endpoint. |

### getActionsCount

`workflowRules.getActionsCount`

Get Workflow Rule Action Counts. To retrieve the total number of actions configured in the specified workflow rules in your Zoho CRM organization, including counts categorized by action type across both instant and scheduled actions.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.workflowRules.getActionsCount({ ids: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ids` | `string` | Yes | Specifies one or more workflow rule IDs to filter the results. Provide multiple IDs as comma-separated values. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  workflow_rules?: {
    id?: string | null,
    conditions?: {
      sequence_number?: number | null,
      instant_actions?: {
        actions_count?: {
          type?: string | null,
          value?: number | null
        }[] | null
      } | null | null,
      scheduled_actions?: {
        actions_count?: {
          type?: string | null,
          value?: number | null
        }[] | null
      }[] | null | null,
      id?: string | null
    }[] | null
  }[] | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### getConfigurations

`workflowRules.getConfigurations`

Workflow Configuration. Retrieves the available triggers, actions, and related trigger details for a specific module. Use this endpoint before creating or updating workflow rules to discover which triggers and actions are supported, their per-type limits, scheduling compatibility, and related module triggers.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.workflowRules.getConfigurations({ module: 'Leads' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the CRM module for which you want to retrieve workflow configuration metadata. Must be a workflow-supported module (for example, Leads, Contacts, Deals, Accounts, Tasks, Cases, Products, Quotes, Sales_Orders, Purchase_Orders, Invoices, Campaigns, Vendors). Refer to the [Get Modules Metadata API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  workflow_configurations?: {
    related_triggers_details?: {
      api_name?: string | null,
      module?: {
        singular_label?: string | null,
        plural_label?: string | null,
        api_name?: string | null,
        name?: string | null,
        id?: string | null
      } | null,
      name?: string | null,
      triggers?: {
        api_name?: string | null,
        deprecated?: boolean | null,
        name?: string | null,
        scheduled_actions_supported?: boolean | null,
        actions?: string[] | null,
        component_id?: string | null | null,
        generated_type?: string | null | null
      }[] | null
    }[] | null,
    triggers?: {
      api_name?: string | null,
      deprecated?: boolean | null,
      name?: string | null,
      scheduled_actions_supported?: boolean | null,
      actions?: string[] | null,
      component_id?: string | null | null,
      generated_type?: string | null | null
    }[] | null,
    actions?: {
      is_clickable?: boolean | null,
      associate_action?: boolean | null,
      limit_per_action?: number | null | null,
      api_name?: string | null,
      supported_in_scheduled_action?: boolean | null,
      name?: string | null,
      limit?: number | null
    }[] | null
  } | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```

### getUsage

`workflowRules.getUsage`

Retrieve Action Usage for a Workflow Rule. To retrieve the action usage report for a specific workflow rule in your Zoho CRM organization, including trigger count and per-action success, failure, and queue metrics, as well as email engagement statistics. Results are scoped to a configurable date range.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.workflowRules.getUsage({ executed_from: 'example', executed_till: 'example', workflowRuleId: 'example' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `executed_from` | `string` | Yes | Specifies the start date of the usage data query window in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd). |
| `executed_till` | `string` | Yes | Specifies the end date of the usage data query window in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd). |
| `workflowRuleId` | `string` | Yes | Represents the unique 19-digit numeric ID of the workflow rule to target. Obtain valid IDs from the List Workflow Rules endpoint. |

### list

`workflowRules.list`

List Workflow Rules in your Zoho CRM Organization. To retrieve the list of workflow rules configured in your Zoho CRM organization, including their trigger conditions, module associations, and action configurations.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.workflowRules.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | Specifies the page number for paginated results. Page numbering starts at 1. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specifies the number of workflow rules to return per page. The default and maximum value is 200. |
| `module` | `string` | No | Specifies the CRM module API name to filter workflow rules by, such as Leads, Contacts, or Deals. |
| `status_active` | `boolean` | No | Filters workflow rules by activation status. Set to true to return only active rules, or false to return only inactive rules. |
| `execute_on` | `string` | No | Specifies the trigger type to filter workflow rules by, such as create, edit, or delete events. |
| `sort_order` | `asc \| desc` | No | Specifies the sort direction for the workflow rule list. Accepted values are `asc` and `desc`. |
| `sort_by` | `string` | No | Specifies the field to sort workflow rules by. Only `modified_time` is supported. |
| `include_inner_details` | `string` | No | Includes the `conditions` array with its criteria and action configurations in the response. Pass the complete list of keys, separated by commas: `conditions,conditions.instant_actions,conditions.criteria_details,conditions.scheduled_actions`. Omit this parameter to return only summary-level rule details. |
| `filter` | `string` | No | Specifies a JSON filter expression to search workflow rules by name. Supports only contains-type matching on the rule name field. |



**Output:** `object`

### reorder

`workflowRules.reorder`

Update Workflow Rule Execution Order for Module. To update the execution order of workflow rules for a specific module in your Zoho CRM organization. By default, rules execute in the order in which they were created. If any of the specified rule IDs are invalid, the entire request fails and no partial updates are applied.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.workflowRules.reorder({
	reorder: {},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | No | Specifies the CRM module API name to filter workflow rules by, such as Leads, Contacts, or Deals. |
| `reorder` | `object` | Yes | Represents the reorder payload containing the list of workflow rules and their updated execution order. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="reorder full type">

```ts
{
  workflow_rules?: {
    module_specific_sequence: number | string,
    id: string
  }[]
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `reorder` | `object[] \| null` | No | Represents the array of workflow rule objects with their updated execution order. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="reorder full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### update

`workflowRules.update`

Update Workflow Rule by ID. To update an existing workflow rule in your Zoho CRM organization, use this operation with the rule's unique ID. You can modify the rule's name, description, triggers, criteria, conditions, and actions, or activate and deactivate the rule.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.workflowRules.update({
	id: '4876876000000333001',
	workflow_rules: [{}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Represents the unique 19-digit numeric ID of the workflow rule. Obtain valid IDs from the List Workflow Rules endpoint. |
| `workflow_rules` | `object[]` | Yes | The request body must contain a **workflow_rules** array with one object. |

### updateMany

`workflowRules.updateMany`

Update workflow rules by ID in the request body. To update one or more existing workflow rules in your Zoho CRM organization, submit a workflow_rules array in the request body with each entry containing the rule's id. You can modify a rule's name, description, criteria, conditions, actions, and active status.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.workflowRules.updateMany({
	workflow_rules: [{}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `workflow_rules` | `object[]` | Yes | The request body must contain a **workflow_rules** array with one object. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="workflow_rules full type">

```ts
{
  id?: string,
  status?: {
    active?: boolean,
    delete_schedule_action?: boolean
```

### delete

`workflowTasks.delete`

Automation Task. PURPOSE: Deletes a single automation task definition by its ID. MANDATORY: id path parameter (string - automation task definition ID, not a Task record ID). KEY CONSTRAINTS: Tasks associated with active workflow rules, approval processes, or blueprints cannot be deleted (returns NOT_ALLOWED). Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.workflowTasks.delete({ id: '4876876000000333001' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | Represents the unique ID of the task that you want to delete. Skip this parameter if you have specified the ID in the request URL. You can pass upto 10 comma-separated IDs in this parameter. Tasks associated with active workflow rules, approval processes, or blueprints cannot be deleted. Use the [Workflow Tasks API](workflow_tasks.yaml#$.paths./settings/automation/tasks.get) to retrieve the ID. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `tasks` | `object[] \| null` | No | Contains one success result object for the deleted task. |

```ts
  details?: {

    id?: string | null

  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>

### list

`workflowTasks.list`

List automation task definitions with optional filters. PURPOSE: Retrieves a paginated list of automation task definitions. Supports filtering by module, feature_type, and name (via filter param). PAGINATION: page (default 1), per_page (default 200, max 200). Use info.more_records to determine if additional pages exist.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.workflowTasks.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `filter` | `string` | No | Filter object to search tasks by name. Supported shape: field.api_name must be 'name', comparator must be 'contains', and value is the search string. Example: &#123;"field":&#123;"api_name":"name"&#125;,"comparator":"contains","value":"follow up"&#125; |
| `feature_type` | `workflow \| approval_process \| blueprint \| kiosks \| scoring_rule \| case_escalation_rule \| blueprint_transition \| blueprint_state \| review_process \| orchestration \| assignment_rules \| pathfinder \| connected_workflows \| commandcenter_service \| cadences` | No | Filter tasks by automation feature type. The filter accepts more values than POST does - values like `blueprint_transition`, `review_process`, and `orchestration` are system-created task types that can be retrieved but not created via POST. For POST, only `workflow`, `approval_process`, `Blueprint`, `kiosks`, `scoring_rule`, and `case_escalation_rule` are valid. |
| `module` | `string` | No | Filter tasks by CRM module API name (for example: Leads, Contacts, Deals). |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify how many tasks to return per page. The default and the maximum possible value is 200. |
| `page` | `number \| string` | No | To get the list of tasks from the respective pages. The default value is 1. Possible values: Positive integer values only. |
| `sort_by` | `string` | No | Sort field. Currently only modified_time supported. |
| `sort_order` | `desc \| asc` | No | Sort order for the results based on sort_by. Possible values: desc, asc. |

```ts
	data_enrichment: [{

			crm_field: { id: '4876876000000333001', api_name: 'example' },
		}],
		output_data_field_mapping: [{

});
```

### orgEnrichment.create

`zia.orgEnrichment.create`

Trigger organization-level enrichment for a CRM record. To submit a request that schedules a Zia organization enrichment job in your Zoho CRM organization.

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.zia.orgEnrichment.create({
	module: 'Leads',
	__zia_org_enrichment: [{
		enrich_based_on: { name: 'example' },
	}],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `module` | `string` | Yes | Specify the API name of the CRM module for which enrichment is to be triggered. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve the list of valid module API names. |
| `record_id` | `string` | No | Specify the unique identifier of the record for which enrichment is to be triggered. When omitted, the job runs at the module level. Use the records API of the target module to retrieve record identifiers. |
| `__zia_org_enrichment` | `object[]` | Yes | Specify the list of enrichment requests to schedule. You can supply up to 50 entries in a single call. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="__zia_org_enrichment full type">

```ts
{
  enrich_based_on: {
    name: string,
    email?: string,
    website?: string
  }
}[]
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `__zia_org_enrichment` | `object[] \| null` | No | Contains the list of scheduling results, one entry per submitted enrichment request. |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="__zia_org_enrichment full type">

```ts
{
  code?: string | null,
  details?: {
    id?: string | null
  } | null,
  message?: string | null,
  status?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### orgEnrichment.list

`zia.orgEnrichment.list`

Get Zia Org Enrichment. To retrieve the paginated list of Zia organization enrichment jobs that have been scheduled in your Zoho CRM organization. Each entry includes the job identifier, current status, creation timestamp, and the user who triggered the job.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.zohocrm.api.zia.orgEnrichment.list({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `page` | `1 \| 2` | No | Specify the page number to retrieve the list of records from the paginated results. Default value is 1. Accepts only positive integer values. |
| `per_page` | `number \| string` | No | Specify the number of records to retrieve per page. Default and maximum value is 100. |
| `sort_by` | `string` | No | Specify the field to use for sorting the response based on created time. Accepts the literal value `created_time`. |
| `sort_order` | `asc \| desc` | No | Specify the direction(ascending or descending) in which to sort the response. Possible values: **asc** - Sort results in ascending order. **desc** - Sort results in descending order. |
| `status` | `COMPLETED \| FAILED \| DATA_NOT_FOUND \| SCHEDULED` | No | Filter the response by the status of the scheduled enrichment job, using the create org enrichment API. Possible values: **COMPLETED** - Returns jobs that finished and produced enriched data. **FAILED** - Returns jobs that ended with a failure. **DATA_NOT_FOUND** - Returns jobs that completed but could not locate any public data to enrich. **SCHEDULED** - Returns jobs that are queued and yet to run. |



**Output:** `object`

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Output full type">

```ts
{
  __zia_org_enrichment?: {
    id?: string | null,
    status?: string | null,
    created_time?: string | null,
    created_by?: {
      id?: string | null,
      name?: string | null
    } | null
  }[] | null,
  info?: {
    per_page?: number | null,
    count?: number | null,
    page?: number | null,
    more_records?: boolean | null
  } | null
} | {
  success: true
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>
